-- @prop gear none
-- Elder Mu greets the Player at the sect gate, once.
local spoken = true
function on_tick()
  if spoken then return end
  local player = world.find("Player")
  if not player then return end
  local px, _, pz = world.position(player)
  local dx, dz = px - self.x, pz - self.z
  if dx * dx + dz * dz > 36 then return end
  spoken = true
  start(function()
    hud.announce("Elder Mu: Welcome, disciple. Qi is the river of the martial world.")
    wait(4)
    hud.announce("Elder Mu: Hold N and sit still to gather it. Then press B with a Breakthrough Pill.")
    wait(5)
    hud.announce("Elder Mu: Bandits in the valley have taken the road. Clear them, then face the guardian at the shrine.")
  end)
end

function on_start()
  if props.gear and props.gear ~= "" and props.gear ~= "none" then world.wear(props.gear) end
end

-- Who fights at what strength (the scene builder places this in front of the scripts that need it, with the table filled in).
-- Realm 1 to 7, the same ladder the Player climbs: a fighter of the Player's own realm is an even fight; two realms above
-- is a different kind of danger. Strength is fixed by who they are and where they stand, and nothing scales to the Player.
BEST = { ["Millstream Wolf 1"] = 1, ["Millstream Wolf 2"] = 1, ["Millstream Wolf 3"] = 1, ["Roadside Bandit"] = 1, ["Disciple Fen"] = 1, ["Gray Mane"] = 2, ["Bamboo Wolf 1"] = 2, ["Bamboo Wolf 2"] = 2, ["Black Wind Scout 1"] = 2, ["Black Wind Scout 2"] = 2, ["Black Wind Scout 3"] = 2, ["Captain Rook"] = 3, ["Old Lotus"] = 3, ["Grove Spirit 1"] = 3, ["Grove Spirit 2"] = 3, ["Smuggler 1"] = 2, ["Smuggler 2"] = 2, ["Smuggler 3"] = 2, ["Boss Kang"] = 3, ["Silver Hand Wei"] = 3, ["Iron Fist Elder"] = 4, ["Blood Lotus Duelist"] = 5, ["Frostfang Warden"] = 5, ["Bone Warlord"] = 6 }
PEACEFUL = { ["Disciple Fen"] = true, ["Old Lotus"] = true, ["Silver Hand Wei"] = true, ["Blood Lotus Duelist"] = true }

-- The realm a named fighter stands at: its entry, else its name's first matching word, else 1.
function realm_of(name)
  name = tostring(name or "")
  if BEST[name] then return BEST[name] end
  for pattern, realm in pairs(BEST_BY_WORD) do
    if name:find(pattern) then return realm end
  end
  return 1
end
BEST_BY_WORD = {}

-- What a fight against `them` is for someone of realm `mine`: a short label, the colour word, and a danger from 0 to 4.
function threat_of(them, mine)
  local d = them - mine
  if d <= -2 then return "Trivial", "grey", 0
  elseif d == -1 then return "Easy", "green", 0
  elseif d == 0 then return "Even", "yellow", 1
  elseif d == 1 then return "Hard", "orange", 2
  elseif d == 2 then return "Deadly", "red", 3
  else return "Hopeless", "black", 4 end
end

-- @prop kind deer
-- @prop loot none
-- Animals you can hunt: a deer gives raw venison and a hide; a wolf (it chases on its own) gives a pelt, qi and trouble.
-- A named beast (props.loot) drops its trophy as well, and every kill is reported by name for the quests.
function on_death(attacker)
  local player = world.find("Player")
  if not player then return end
  local kind = props.kind or "deer"
  if kind == "deer" then
    inventory.add(player, "Raw Venison", math.random(1, 2))
    inventory.add(player, "Deer Hide", 1)
    hud.announce("You skin the deer.")
  else
    inventory.add(player, "Wolf Pelt", 1)
    world.send(player, "kill", 12 * (realm_of(world.name(self.id)) ^ 1.4))
    if props.loot ~= "none" then
      inventory.add(player, props.loot, 1)
      hud.announce("It drops: " .. props.loot .. ".")
    end
    world.send(player, "slain", world.name(self.id) or "Wolf")
  end
end

-- @prop gear none
-- @prop qi 25
-- @prop drop 0
-- @prop pill 0
-- @prop silver 0
-- @prop arrows 0
-- @prop phases 0
-- @prop telegraph none
-- @prop summon Cave Shade
-- @prop loot none
-- @prop dungeon 0
-- @prop realm 0
-- @prop peaceful 0
-- @prop duel 0
-- @prop reward none
-- A bandit, a beast or a guardian: qi and loot for the Player when defeated; afflictions (burn, poison, bleed, chill,
-- stun) from qi arts; a red ring before a heavy blow (props.telegraph lists the moves); calls its friends when hurt;
-- and, with props.phases, a boss that grows angrier and calls help at two thirds and one third of its health.
local afflictions = {}          -- name -> seconds left
local DPS = { burn = 4, poison = 3, bleed = 4 }
local dot_acc = 0
local last_move = ""
local phase = 0
local alert_left = 0
local telegraph = {}
-- A fighter's realm sets how hard it hits and how fast it moves (the Player's own ladder: an equal is an even fight).
local REALM_DAMAGE = { 1.0, 1.25, 1.6, 2.1, 2.7, 3.5, 5.0 }
local REALM_SPEED = { 1.0, 1.05, 1.1, 1.18, 1.25, 1.32, 1.4 }
local my_realm = 1
local base_damage = 1
local yielded = false

function on_death(attacker)
  local player = world.find("Player")
  if not player then return end

-- Realm 1 to 7, the same ladder the Player climbs: a fighter of the Player's own realm is an even fight; two realms above
-- is a different kind of danger. Strength is fixed by who they are and where they stand, and nothing scales to the Player.
BEST = { ["Millstream Wolf 1"] = 1, ["Millstream Wolf 2"] = 1, ["Millstream Wolf 3"] = 1, ["Roadside Bandit"] = 1, ["Disciple Fen"] = 1, ["Gray Mane"] = 2, ["Bamboo Wolf 1"] = 2, ["Bamboo Wolf 2"] = 2, ["Black Wind Scout 1"] = 2, ["Black Wind Scout 2"] = 2, ["Black Wind Scout 3"] = 2, ["Captain Rook"] = 3, ["Old Lotus"] = 3, ["Grove Spirit 1"] = 3, ["Grove Spirit 2"] = 3, ["Smuggler 1"] = 2, ["Smuggler 2"] = 2, ["Smuggler 3"] = 2, ["Boss Kang"] = 3, ["Silver Hand Wei"] = 3, ["Iron Fist Elder"] = 4, ["Blood Lotus Duelist"] = 5, ["Frostfang Warden"] = 5, ["Bone Warlord"] = 6 }
PEACEFUL = { ["Disciple Fen"] = true, ["Old Lotus"] = true, ["Silver Hand Wei"] = true, ["Blood Lotus Duelist"] = true }

-- The realm a named fighter stands at: its entry, else its name's first matching word, else 1.
function realm_of(name)

  if BEST[name] then return BEST[name] end
  for pattern, realm in pairs(BEST_BY_WORD) do
    if name:find(pattern) then return realm end
  end
  return 1
end
BEST_BY_WORD = {}

-- What a fight against `them` is for someone of realm `mine`: a short label, the colour word, and a danger from 0 to 4.
function threat_of(them, mine)
  local d = them - mine
  if d <= -2 then return "Trivial", "grey", 0
  elseif d == -1 then return "Easy", "green", 0
  elseif d == 0 then return "Even", "yellow", 1
  elseif d == 1 then return "Hard", "orange", 2
  elseif d == 2 then return "Deadly", "red", 3
  else return "Hopeless", "black", 4 end
end

-- @prop gear none
-- @prop qi 25
-- @prop drop 0
-- @prop pill 0
-- @prop silver 0
-- @prop arrows 0
-- @prop phases 0
-- @prop telegraph none
-- @prop summon Cave Shade
-- @prop loot none
-- @prop dungeon 0
-- @prop realm 0
-- @prop peaceful 0
-- @prop duel 0
-- @prop reward none
-- A bandit, a beast or a guardian: qi and loot for the Player when defeated; afflictions (burn, poison, bleed, chill,
-- stun) from qi arts; a red ring before a heavy blow (props.telegraph lists the moves); calls its friends when hurt;
-- and, with props.phases, a boss that grows angrier and calls help at two thirds and one third of its health.
local afflictions = {}          -- name -> seconds left
local DPS = { burn = 4, poison = 3, bleed = 4 }
local dot_acc = 0
local last_move = ""
local phase = 0
local alert_left = 0
local telegraph = {}
-- A fighter's realm sets how hard it hits and how fast it moves (the Player's own ladder: an equal is an even fight).
local REALM_DAMAGE = { 1.0, 1.25, 1.6, 2.1, 2.7, 3.5, 5.0 }
local REALM_SPEED = { 1.0, 1.05, 1.1, 1.18, 1.25, 1.32, 1.4 }
local my_realm = 1
local base_damage = 1
local yielded = false

function on_death(attacker)
  local player = world.find("Player")
  if not player then return end
  world.send(player, "kill", tonumber(props.qi) or 25)
  if (tonumber(props.silver) or 0) > 0 then inventory.add(player, "Silver", tonumber(props.silver)) end
  if (props.drop or 0) > 0 then inventory.add(player, "Qi Elixir", props.drop) end
  local arrows = tonumber(props.arrows) or 0
  if arrows > 0 or math.random() < 0.3 then inventory.add(player, "Arrow", math.max(arrows, math.random(2, 4))) end
  if math.random() < 0.15 then inventory.add(player, "Jade Dew Pill", 1) end
  if (props.pill or 0) > 0 then
    inventory.add(player, "Breakthrough Pill", props.pill)
    hud.announce("The guardian drops a Breakthrough Pill.")
  end
  for item in tostring(props.loot or ""):gmatch("[^|]+") do
    if item ~= "none" then
      inventory.add(player, item, 1)
      hud.announce("It drops: " .. item .. ".")
    end
  end
  if (tonumber(props.dungeon) or 0) > 0 then
    local sect = world.find("Sect")
    if sect then world.send(sect, "dungeon", "") end
  end
  world.send(player, "slain", world.name(self.id) or "")
end

local function mark_ring(secs)
  local mark = world.find("Qi Mark")
  if mark then world.send(mark, "at", string.format("%.2f,%.2f,%.2f,%.2f", self.x, self.y - 0.8, self.z, secs)) end
end

local function call_friends()
  for _, id in ipairs(world.overlap(self.x, self.y, self.z, 18)) do
    if id ~= self.id and world.alive(id) then
      local n = world.name(id) or ""
      if BEST[n] and not PEACEFUL[n] then world.send(id, "alert", "") end
    end
  end
end

function on_message(name, value)
  if name == "status" then
    local kind, secs = tostring(value):match("^(%a+)|([%d.]+)$")
    if kind then
      afflictions[kind] = tonumber(secs)
      if kind == "chill" then melee.tune(-1, 0.55) end
      if kind == "stun" then melee.set_ai(false) end
    end
  elseif name == "challenge" then
    -- "Fight me" said to a duelist: it takes up the duel.
    props.peaceful = 0
    melee.set_ai(true, 0.7)
    local player = world.find("Player")
    if player then melee.lock(player) end
  elseif name == "alert" and alert_left <= 0 then
    alert_left = 12
    melee.set_ai(true, 0.85)
    local player = world.find("Player")
    if player then melee.lock(player) end
  end
end

function on_damaged(amount, attacker)
  -- A duel is to first yield, not to the death: at a quarter of its health the duelist stops, heals a little and pays up.
  if (tonumber(props.duel) or 0) > 0 and not yielded then
    local hp, max = world.health(self.id)
    if hp and max and hp <= max * 0.25 then
      yielded = true
      melee.set_ai(false)
      world.heal(self.id, max * 0.3 - hp)
      local player = world.find("Player")
      hud.announce((world.name(self.id) or "The duelist") .. " yields. \"Enough. You have earned this.\"")
      if player then
        world.send(player, "duel_won", world.name(self.id) or "")
        if props.reward ~= "none" then
          for item in tostring(props.reward):gmatch("[^|]+") do inventory.add(player, item, 1) hud.announce("You receive: " .. item .. ".") end
        end
        world.send(player, "kill", (tonumber(props.qi) or 25))
      end
      return
    end
  end
  -- Someone who stood peacefully fights back once struck.
  if (tonumber(props.peaceful) or 0) > 0 and not yielded then
    props.peaceful = 0
    melee.set_ai(true, 0.7)
    local player = world.find("Player")
    if player then melee.lock(player) end
  end
  if alert_left <= 0 and not PEACEFUL[world.name(self.id) or ""] and (tonumber(props.phases) or 0) == 0 then
    alert_left = 12
    call_friends()
  end
  if (tonumber(props.phases) or 0) > 0 then
    local hp, max = world.health(self.id)
    if hp and max and max > 0 then
      local ratio = hp / max
      local want = ratio < 0.34 and 2 or ratio < 0.67 and 1 or 0
      if want > phase then
        phase = want
        melee.tune(base_damage * (1 + 0.3 * phase), REALM_SPEED[my_realm] * (1 + 0.08 * phase), -1, -1)
        camera.shake(0.5, 0.5)
        hud.announce(phase == 1 and "The guardian's qi surges." or "The guardian's qi blazes. It will not fall easily.")
        for k = 1, 2 do
          local ang = k * math.pi + phase
          world.spawn(props.summon or "Cave Shade", self.x + math.cos(ang) * 3, self.y + 0.5, self.z + math.sin(ang) * 3)
        end
      end
    end
  end
end

function on_tick(dt)
  if alert_left > 0 then alert_left = alert_left - dt end
  -- Afflictions.
  for kind, left in pairs(afflictions) do
    left = left - dt
    if DPS[kind] then dot_acc = dot_acc + DPS[kind] * dt end
    if left <= 0 then
      afflictions[kind] = nil
      if kind == "chill" then melee.tune(-1, 1) end
      if kind == "stun" then melee.set_ai(true) end
    else
      afflictions[kind] = left
    end
  end
  if dot_acc >= 1 then
    local whole = math.floor(dot_acc)
    dot_acc = dot_acc - whole
    world.damage(self.id, whole)
  end
  -- A ring on the ground the moment a telegraphed blow begins.
  if next(telegraph) then
    local move = melee.move()
    if move ~= last_move then
      last_move = move
      if telegraph[move] then mark_ring(0.7) end
    end
  end
end

function on_start()
  local given = tonumber(props.realm) or 0
  my_realm = math.max(1, math.min(7, given > 0 and given or realm_of(world.name(self.id))))
  base_damage = REALM_DAMAGE[my_realm]
  melee.tune(base_damage, REALM_SPEED[my_realm], -1, -1)
  if (tonumber(props.peaceful) or 0) > 0 then melee.set_ai(false) end
  -- Clothes give the mannequin a body: robes, trousers, gloves and boots.
  if props.gear and props.gear ~= "" and props.gear ~= "none" then world.wear(props.gear) end
  for name in tostring(props.telegraph or ""):gmatch("[%w_]+") do
    if name ~= "none" then telegraph[name] = true end
  end
end

function realm_of(name)
  name = tostring(name or "")
  if BEST[name] then return BEST[name] end
  for pattern, realm in pairs(BEST_BY_WORD) do
    if name:find(pattern) then return realm end
  end
  return 1
end
BEST_BY_WORD = {}

-- What a fight against `them` is for someone of realm `mine`: a short label, the colour word, and a danger from 0 to 4.
function threat_of(them, mine)
  local d = them - mine
  if d <= -2 then return "Trivial", "grey", 0
  elseif d == -1 then return "Easy", "green", 0
  elseif d == 0 then return "Even", "yellow", 1
  elseif d == 1 then return "Hard", "orange", 2

BEST = { ["Millstream Wolf 1"] = 1, ["Millstream Wolf 2"] = 1, ["Millstream Wolf 3"] = 1, ["Roadside Bandit"] = 1, ["Disciple Fen"] = 1, ["Gray Mane"] = 2, ["Bamboo Wolf 1"] = 2, ["Bamboo Wolf 2"] = 2, ["Black Wind Scout 1"] = 2, ["Black Wind Scout 2"] = 2, ["Black Wind Scout 3"] = 2, ["Captain Rook"] = 3, ["Old Lotus"] = 3, ["Grove Spirit 1"] = 3, ["Grove Spirit 2"] = 3, ["Smuggler 1"] = 2, ["Smuggler 2"] = 2, ["Smuggler 3"] = 2, ["Boss Kang"] = 3, ["Silver Hand Wei"] = 3, ["Iron Fist Elder"] = 4, ["Blood Lotus Duelist"] = 5, ["Frostfang Warden"] = 5, ["Bone Warlord"] = 6 }
PEACEFUL = { ["Disciple Fen"] = true, ["Old Lotus"] = true, ["Silver Hand Wei"] = true, ["Blood Lotus Duelist"] = true }

-- The realm a named fighter stands at: its entry, else its name's first matching word, else 1.
function realm_of(name)
  name = tostring(name or "")
  if BEST[name] then return BEST[name] end
  for pattern, realm in pairs(BEST_BY_WORD) do
    if name:find(pattern) then return realm end
  end
  return 1
end
BEST_BY_WORD = {}

-- What a fight against `them` is for someone of realm `mine`: a short label, the colour word, and a danger from 0 to 4.
function threat_of(them, mine)
  local d = them - mine
  if d <= -2 then return "Trivial", "grey", 0
  elseif d == -1 then return "Easy", "green", 0
  elseif d == 0 then return "Even", "yellow", 1
  elseif d == 1 then return "Hard", "orange", 2
  elseif d == 2 then return "Deadly", "red", 3
  else return "Hopeless", "black", 4 end
end

-- @prop gear none
-- @prop qi 25
-- @prop drop 0
-- @prop pill 0
-- @prop silver 0
-- @prop arrows 0
-- @prop phases 0
-- @prop telegraph none
-- @prop summon Cave Shade
-- @prop loot none
-- @prop dungeon 0
-- @prop realm 0
-- @prop peaceful 0
-- @prop duel 0
-- @prop reward none
-- A bandit, a beast or a guardian: qi and loot for the Player when defeated; afflictions (burn, poison, bleed, chill,
-- stun) from qi arts; a red ring before a heavy blow (props.telegraph lists the moves); calls its friends when hurt;
-- and, with props.phases, a boss that grows angrier and calls help at two thirds and one third of its health.
local afflictions = {}          -- name -> seconds left
local DPS = { burn = 4, poison = 3, bleed = 4 }
local dot_acc = 0
local last_move = ""
local phase = 0
local alert_left = 0
local telegraph = {}
-- A fighter's realm sets how hard it hits and how fast it moves (the Player's own ladder: an equal is an even fight).
local REALM_DAMAGE = { 1.0, 1.25, 1.6, 2.1, 2.7, 3.5, 5.0 }
local REALM_SPEED = { 1.0, 1.05, 1.1, 1.18, 1.25, 1.32, 1.4 }
local my_realm = 1
local base_damage = 1
local yielded = false

function on_death(attacker)
  local player = world.find("Player")
  if not player then return end
  world.send(player, "kill", tonumber(props.qi) or 25)
  if (tonumber(props.silver) or 0) > 0 then inventory.add(player, "Silver", tonumber(props.silver)) end
  if (props.drop or 0) > 0 then inventory.add(player, "Qi Elixir", props.drop) end
  local arrows = tonumber(props.arrows) or 0
  if arrows > 0 or math.random() < 0.3 then inventory.add(player, "Arrow", math.max(arrows, math.random(2, 4))) end
  if math.random() < 0.15 then inventory.add(player, "Jade Dew Pill", 1) end
  if (props.pill or 0) > 0 then
    inventory.add(player, "Breakthrough Pill", props.pill)
    hud.announce("The guardian drops a Breakthrough Pill.")
  end
  for item in tostring(props.loot or ""):gmatch("[^|]+") do
    if item ~= "none" then
      inventory.add(player, item, 1)
      hud.announce("It drops: " .. item .. ".")
    end
  end
  if (tonumber(props.dungeon) or 0) > 0 then
    local sect = world.find("Sect")
    if sect then world.send(sect, "dungeon", "") end
  end
  world.send(player, "slain", world.name(self.id) or "")
end

local function mark_ring(secs)
  local mark = world.find("Qi Mark")
  if mark then world.send(mark, "at", string.format("%.2f,%.2f,%.2f,%.2f", self.x, self.y - 0.8, self.z, secs)) end
end

local function call_friends()
  for _, id in ipairs(world.overlap(self.x, self.y, self.z, 18)) do
    if id ~= self.id and world.alive(id) then
      local n = world.name(id) or ""
      if BEST[n] and not PEACEFUL[n] then world.send(id, "alert", "") end
    end
  end
end

function on_message(name, value)
  if name == "status" then
    local kind, secs = tostring(value):match("^(%a+)|([%d.]+)$")
    if kind then
      afflictions[kind] = tonumber(secs)
      if kind == "chill" then melee.tune(-1, 0.55) end
      if kind == "stun" then melee.set_ai(false) end
    end
  elseif name == "challenge" then
    -- "Fight me" said to a duelist: it takes up the duel.
    props.peaceful = 0
    melee.set_ai(true, 0.7)
    local player = world.find("Player")
    if player then melee.lock(player) end
  elseif name == "alert" and alert_left <= 0 then
    alert_left = 12
    melee.set_ai(true, 0.85)
    local player = world.find("Player")
    if player then melee.lock(player) end
  end
end

function on_damaged(amount, attacker)
  -- A duel is to first yield, not to the death: at a quarter of its health the duelist stops, heals a little and pays up.
  if (tonumber(props.duel) or 0) > 0 and not yielded then
    local hp, max = world.health(self.id)
    if hp and max and hp <= max * 0.25 then
      yielded = true
      melee.set_ai(false)
      world.heal(self.id, max * 0.3 - hp)
      local player = world.find("Player")
      hud.announce((world.name(self.id) or "The duelist") .. " yields. \"Enough. You have earned this.\"")
      if player then
        world.send(player, "duel_won", world.name(self.id) or "")
        if props.reward ~= "none" then
          for item in tostring(props.reward):gmatch("[^|]+") do inventory.add(player, item, 1) hud.announce("You receive: " .. item .. ".") end
        end
        world.send(player, "kill", (tonumber(props.qi) or 25))
      end
      return
    end
  end
  -- Someone who stood peacefully fights back once struck.
  if (tonumber(props.peaceful) or 0) > 0 and not yielded then
    props.peaceful = 0
    melee.set_ai(true, 0.7)
    local player = world.find("Player")
    if player then melee.lock(player) end
  end
  if alert_left <= 0 and not PEACEFUL[world.name(self.id) or ""] and (tonumber(props.phases) or 0) == 0 then
    alert_left = 12
    call_friends()
  end
  if (tonumber(props.phases) or 0) > 0 then
    local hp, max = world.health(self.id)
    if hp and max and max > 0 then
      local ratio = hp / max
      local want = ratio < 0.34 and 2 or ratio < 0.67 and 1 or 0
      if want > phase then
        phase = want
        melee.tune(base_damage * (1 + 0.3 * phase), REALM_SPEED[my_realm] * (1 + 0.08 * phase), -1, -1)
        camera.shake(0.5, 0.5)
        hud.announce(phase == 1 and "The guardian's qi surges." or "The guardian's qi blazes. It will not fall easily.")
        for k = 1, 2 do
          local ang = k * math.pi + phase
          world.spawn(props.summon or "Cave Shade", self.x + math.cos(ang) * 3, self.y + 0.5, self.z + math.sin(ang) * 3)
        end
      end
    end
  end
end

function on_tick(dt)
  if alert_left > 0 then alert_left = alert_left - dt end
  -- Afflictions.
  for kind, left in pairs(afflictions) do
    left = left - dt
    if DPS[kind] then dot_acc = dot_acc + DPS[kind] * dt end
    if left <= 0 then
      afflictions[kind] = nil
      if kind == "chill" then melee.tune(-1, 1) end
      if kind == "stun" then melee.set_ai(true) end
    else
      afflictions[kind] = left
    end
  end
  if dot_acc >= 1 then
    local whole = math.floor(dot_acc)
    dot_acc = dot_acc - whole
    world.damage(self.id, whole)
  end
  -- A ring on the ground the moment a telegraphed blow begins.
  if next(telegraph) then
    local move = melee.move()
    if move ~= last_move then
      last_move = move
      if telegraph[move] then mark_ring(0.7) end
    end
  end
end

function on_start()
  local given = tonumber(props.realm) or 0
  my_realm = math.max(1, math.min(7, given > 0 and given or realm_of(world.name(self.id))))
  base_damage = REALM_DAMAGE[my_realm]
  melee.tune(base_damage, REALM_SPEED[my_realm], -1, -1)
  if (tonumber(props.peaceful) or 0) > 0 then melee.set_ai(false) end
  -- Clothes give the mannequin a body: robes, trousers, gloves and boots.
  if props.gear and props.gear ~= "" and props.gear ~= "none" then world.wear(props.gear) end
  for name in tostring(props.telegraph or ""):gmatch("[%w_]+") do
    if name ~= "none" then telegraph[name] = true end
  end
end

Script.source:
-- Who fights at what strength (the scene builder places this in front of the scripts that need it, with the table filled in).
-- Realm 1 to 7, the same ladder the Player climbs: a fighter of the Player's own realm is an even fight; two realms above
-- is a different kind of danger. Strength is fixed by who they are and where they stand, and nothing scales to the Player.
BEST = { ["Millstream Wolf 1"] = 1, ["Millstream Wolf 2"] = 1, ["Millstream Wolf 3"] = 1, ["Roadside Bandit"] = 1, ["Disciple Fen"] = 1, ["Gray Mane"] = 2, ["Bamboo Wolf 1"] = 2, ["Bamboo Wolf 2"] = 2, ["Black Wind Scout 1"] = 2, ["Black Wind Scout 2"] = 2, ["Black Wind Scout 3"] = 2, ["Captain Rook"] = 3, ["Old Lotus"] = 3, ["Grove Spirit 1"] = 3, ["Grove Spirit 2"] = 3, ["Smuggler 1"] = 2, ["Smuggler 2"] = 2, ["Smuggler 3"] = 2, ["Boss Kang"] = 3, ["Silver Hand Wei"] = 3, ["Iron Fist Elder"] = 4, ["Blood Lotus Duelist"] = 5, ["Frostfang Warden"] = 5, ["Bone Warlord"] = 6 }
PEACEFUL = { ["Disciple Fen"] = true, ["Old Lotus"] = true, ["Silver Hand Wei"] = true, ["Blood Lotus Duelist"] = true }

-- The realm a named fighter stands at: its entry, else its name's first matching word, else 1.
function realm_of(name)
  name = tostring(name or "")
  if BEST[name] then return BEST[name] end
  for pattern, realm in pairs(BEST_BY_WORD) do
    if name:find(pattern) then return realm end
  end
  return 1
end
BEST_BY_WORD = {}

-- What a fight against `them` is for someone of realm `mine`: a short label, the colour word, and a danger from 0 to 4.
function threat_of(them, mine)
  local d = them - mine
  if d <= -2 then return "Trivial", "grey", 0
  elseif d == -1 then return "Easy", "green", 0
  elseif d == 0 then return "Even", "yellow", 1
  elseif d == 1 then return "Hard", "orange", 2
  elseif d == 2 then return "Deadly", "red", 3
  else return "Hopeless", "black", 4 end
end

-- @prop gear none
-- @prop qi 25
-- @prop drop 0
-- @prop pill 0
-- @prop silver 0
-- @prop arrows 0
-- @prop phases 0
-- @prop telegraph none
-- @prop summon Cave Shade
-- @prop loot none
-- @prop dungeon 0
-- @prop realm 0
-- @prop peaceful 0
-- @prop duel 0
-- @prop reward none
-- A bandit, a beast or a guardian: qi and loot for the Player when defeated; afflictions (burn, poison, bleed, chill,
-- stun) from qi arts; a red ring before a heavy blow (props.telegraph lists the moves); calls its friends when hurt;
-- and, with props.phases, a boss that grows angrier and calls help at two thirds and one third of its health.
local afflictions = {}          -- name -> seconds left
local DPS = { burn = 4, poison = 3, bleed = 4 }
local dot_acc = 0
local last_move = ""
local phase = 0
local alert_left = 0
local telegraph = {}
-- A fighter's realm sets how hard it hits and how fast it moves (the Player's own ladder: an equal is an even fight).
local REALM_DAMAGE = { 1.0, 1.25, 1.6, 2.1, 2.7, 3.5, 5.0 }
local REALM_SPEED = { 1.0, 1.05, 1.1, 1.18, 1.25, 1.32, 1.4 }
local my_realm = 1
local base_damage = 1
local yielded = false

function on_death(attacker)
  local player = world.find("Player")
  if not player then return end
  world.send(player, "kill", tonumber(props.qi) or 25)
  if (tonumber(props.silver) or 0) > 0 then inventory.add(player, "Silver", tonumber(props.silver)) end
  if (props.drop or 0) > 0 then inventory.add(player, "Qi Elixir", props.drop) end
  local arrows = tonumber(props.arrows) or 0
  if arrows > 0 or math.random() < 0.3 then inventory.add(player, "Arrow", math.max(arrows, math.random(2, 4))) end
  if math.random() < 0.15 then inventory.add(player, "Jade Dew Pill", 1) end
  if (props.pill or 0) > 0 then
    inventory.add(player, "Breakthrough Pill", props.pill)
    hud.announce("The guardian drops a Breakthrough Pill.")
  end
  for item in tostring(props.loot or ""):gmatch("[^|]+") do
    if item ~= "none" then
      inventory.add(player, item, 1)
      hud.announce("It drops: " .. item .. ".")
    end
  end
  if (tonumber(props.dungeon) or 0) > 0 then
    local sect = world.find("Sect")
    if sect then world.send(sect, "dungeon", "") end
  end
  world.send(player, "slain", world.name(self.id) or "")
end

local function mark_ring(secs)
  local mark = world.find("Qi Mark")
  if mark then world.send(mark, "at", string.format("%.2f,%.2f,%.2f,%.2f", self.x, self.y - 0.8, self.z, secs)) end
end

local function call_friends()
  for _, id in ipairs(world.overlap(self.x, self.y, self.z, 18)) do
    if id ~= self.id and world.alive(id) then
      local n = world.name(id) or ""
      if BEST[n] and not PEACEFUL[n] then world.send(id, "alert", "") end
    end
  end
end

function on_message(name, value)
  if name == "status" then
    local kind, secs = tostring(value):match("^(%a+)|([%d.]+)$")
    if kind then
      afflictions[kind] = tonumber(secs)
      if kind == "chill" then melee.tune(-1, 0.55) end
      if kind == "stun" then melee.set_ai(false) end
    end
  elseif name == "challenge" then
    -- "Fight me" said to a duelist: it takes up the duel.
    props.peaceful = 0
    melee.set_ai(true, 0.7)
    local player = world.find("Player")
    if player then melee.lock(player) end
  elseif name == "alert" and alert_left <= 0 then
    alert_left = 12
    melee.set_ai(true, 0.85)
    local player = world.find("Player")
    if player then melee.lock(player) end
  end
end

function on_damaged(amount, attacker)
  -- A duel is to first yield, not to the death: at a quarter of its health the duelist stops, heals a little and pays up.
  if (tonumber(props.duel) or 0) > 0 and not yielded then
    local hp, max = world.health(self.id)
    if hp and max and hp <= max * 0.25 then
      yielded = true
      melee.set_ai(false)
      world.heal(self.id, max * 0.3 - hp)
      local player = world.find("Player")
      hud.announce((world.name(self.id) or "The duelist") .. " yields. \"Enough. You have earned this.\"")
      if player then
        world.send(player, "duel_won", world.name(self.id) or "")
        if props.reward ~= "none" then
          for item in tostring(props.reward):gmatch("[^|]+") do inventory.add(player, item, 1) hud.announce("You receive: " .. item .. ".") end
        end
        world.send(player, "kill", (tonumber(props.qi) or 25))
      end
      return
    end
  end
  -- Someone who stood peacefully fights back once struck.
  if (tonumber(props.peaceful) or 0) > 0 and not yielded then
    props.peaceful = 0
    melee.set_ai(true, 0.7)
    local player = world.find("Player")
    if player then melee.lock(player) end
  end
  if alert_left <= 0 and not PEACEFUL[world.name(self.id) or ""] and (tonumber(props.phases) or 0) == 0 then
    alert_left = 12
    call_friends()
  end
  if (tonumber(props.phases) or 0) > 0 then
    local hp, max = world.health(self.id)
    if hp and max and max > 0 then
      local ratio = hp / max
      local want = ratio < 0.34 and 2 or ratio < 0.67 and 1 or 0
      if want > phase then
        phase = want
        melee.tune(base_damage * (1 + 0.3 * phase), REALM_SPEED[my_realm] * (1 + 0.08 * phase), -1, -1)
        camera.shake(0.5, 0.5)
        hud.announce(phase == 1 and "The guardian's qi surges." or "The guardian's qi blazes. It will not fall easily.")
        for k = 1, 2 do
          local ang = k * math.pi + phase
          world.spawn(props.summon or "Cave Shade", self.x + math.cos(ang) * 3, self.y + 0.5, self.z + math.sin(ang) * 3)
        end
      end
    end
  end
end

function on_tick(dt)
  if alert_left > 0 then alert_left = alert_left - dt end
  -- Afflictions.
  for kind, left in pairs(afflictions) do
    left = left - dt
    if DPS[kind] then dot_acc = dot_acc + DPS[kind] * dt end
    if left <= 0 then
      afflictions[kind] = nil
      if kind == "chill" then melee.tune(-1, 1) end
      if kind == "stun" then melee.set_ai(true) end
    else
      afflictions[kind] = left
    end
  end
  if dot_acc >= 1 then
    local whole = math.floor(dot_acc)
    dot_acc = dot_acc - whole
    world.damage(self.id, whole)
  end
  -- A ring on the ground the moment a telegraphed blow begins.
  if next(telegraph) then
    local move = melee.move()
    if move ~= last_move then
      last_move = move
      if telegraph[move] then mark_ring(0.7) end
    end
  end
end

function on_start()
  local given = tonumber(props.realm) or 0
  my_realm = math.max(1, math.min(7, given > 0 and given or realm_of(world.name(self.id))))
  base_damage = REALM_DAMAGE[my_realm]
  melee.tune(base_damage, REALM_SPEED[my_realm], -1, -1)
  if (tonumber(props.peaceful) or 0) > 0 then melee.set_ai(false) end
  -- Clothes give the mannequin a body: robes, trousers, gloves and boots.
  if props.gear and props.gear ~= "" and props.gear ~= "none" then world.wear(props.gear) end
  for name in tostring(props.telegraph or ""):gmatch("[%w_]+") do
    if name ~= "none" then telegraph[name] = true end
  end
end

Script.source:
-- Who fights at what strength (the scene builder places this in front of the scripts that need it, with the table filled in).
-- Realm 1 to 7, the same ladder the Player climbs: a fighter of the Player's own realm is an even fight; two realms above
-- is a different kind of danger. Strength is fixed by who they are and where they stand, and nothing scales to the Player.
BEST = { ["Millstream Wolf 1"] = 1, ["Millstream Wolf 2"] = 1, ["Millstream Wolf 3"] = 1, ["Roadside Bandit"] = 1, ["Disciple Fen"] = 1, ["Gray Mane"] = 2, ["Bamboo Wolf 1"] = 2, ["Bamboo Wolf 2"] = 2, ["Black Wind Scout 1"] = 2, ["Black Wind Scout 2"] = 2, ["Black Wind Scout 3"] = 2, ["Captain Rook"] = 3, ["Old Lotus"] = 3, ["Grove Spirit 1"] = 3, ["Grove Spirit 2"] = 3, ["Smuggler 1"] = 2, ["Smuggler 2"] = 2, ["Smuggler 3"] = 2, ["Boss Kang"] = 3, ["Silver Hand Wei"] = 3, ["Iron Fist Elder"] = 4, ["Blood Lotus Duelist"] = 5, ["Frostfang Warden"] = 5, ["Bone Warlord"] = 6 }
PEACEFUL = { ["Disciple Fen"] = true, ["Old Lotus"] = true, ["Silver Hand Wei"] = true, ["Blood Lotus Duelist"] = true }

-- The realm a named fighter stands at: its entry, else its name's first matching word, else 1.
function realm_of(name)
  name = tostring(name or "")
  if BEST[name] then return BEST[name] end
  for pattern, realm in pairs(BEST_BY_WORD) do
    if name:find(pattern) then return realm end
  end
  return 1
end
BEST_BY_WORD = {}

-- What a fight against `them` is for someone of realm `mine`: a short label, the colour word, and a danger from 0 to 4.
function threat_of(them, mine)
  local d = them - mine
  if d <= -2 then return "Trivial", "grey", 0
  elseif d == -1 then return "Easy", "green", 0
  elseif d == 0 then return "Even", "yellow", 1
  elseif d == 1 then return "Hard", "orange", 2
  elseif d == 2 then return "Deadly", "red", 3
  else return "Hopeless", "black", 4 end
end

-- @prop gear none
-- @prop qi 25
-- @prop drop 0
-- @prop pill 0
-- @prop silver 0
-- @prop arrows 0
-- @prop phases 0
-- @prop telegraph none
-- @prop summon Cave Shade
-- @prop loot none
-- @prop dungeon 0
-- @prop realm 0
-- @prop peaceful 0
-- @prop duel 0
-- @prop reward none
-- A bandit, a beast or a guardian: qi and loot for the Player when defeated; afflictions (burn, poison, bleed, chill,
-- stun) from qi arts; a red ring before a heavy blow (props.telegraph lists the moves); calls its friends when hurt;
-- and, with props.phases, a boss that grows angrier and calls help at two thirds and one third of its health.
local afflictions = {}          -- name -> seconds left
local DPS = { burn = 4, poison = 3, bleed = 4 }
local dot_acc = 0
local last_move = ""
local phase = 0
local alert_left = 0
local telegraph = {}
-- A fighter's realm sets how hard it hits and how fast it moves (the Player's own ladder: an equal is an even fight).
local REALM_DAMAGE = { 1.0, 1.25, 1.6, 2.1, 2.7, 3.5, 5.0 }
local REALM_SPEED = { 1.0, 1.05, 1.1, 1.18, 1.25, 1.32, 1.4 }
local my_realm = 1
local base_damage = 1
local yielded = false

function on_death(attacker)
  local player = world.find("Player")
  if not player then return end
  world.send(player, "kill", tonumber(props.qi) or 25)
  if (tonumber(props.silver) or 0) > 0 then inventory.add(player, "Silver", tonumber(props.silver)) end
  if (props.drop or 0) > 0 then inventory.add(player, "Qi Elixir", props.drop) end
  local arrows = tonumber(props.arrows) or 0
  if arrows > 0 or math.random() < 0.3 then inventory.add(player, "Arrow", math.max(arrows, math.random(2, 4))) end
  if math.random() < 0.15 then inventory.add(player, "Jade Dew Pill", 1) end
  if (props.pill or 0) > 0 then
    inventory.add(player, "Breakthrough Pill", props.pill)
    hud.announce("The guardian drops a Breakthrough Pill.")
  end
  for item in tostring(props.loot or ""):gmatch("[^|]+") do
    if item ~= "none" then
      inventory.add(player, item, 1)
      hud.announce("It drops: " .. item .. ".")
    end
  end
  if (tonumber(props.dungeon) or 0) > 0 then
    local sect = world.find("Sect")
    if sect then world.send(sect, "dungeon", "") end
  end
  world.send(player, "slain", world.name(self.id) or "")
end

local function mark_ring(secs)
  local mark = world.find("Qi Mark")
  if mark then world.send(mark, "at", string.format("%.2f,%.2f,%.2f,%.2f", self.x, self.y - 0.8, self.z, secs)) end
end

local function call_friends()
  for _, id in ipairs(world.overlap(self.x, self.y, self.z, 18)) do
    if id ~= self.id and world.alive(id) then
      local n = world.name(id) or ""
      if BEST[n] and not PEACEFUL[n] then world.send(id, "alert", "") end
    end
  end
end

function on_message(name, value)
  if name == "status" then
    local kind, secs = tostring(value):match("^(%a+)|([%d.]+)$")
    if kind then
      afflictions[kind] = tonumber(secs)
      if kind == "chill" then melee.tune(-1, 0.55) end
      if kind == "stun" then melee.set_ai(false) end
    end
  elseif name == "challenge" then
    -- "Fight me" said to a duelist: it takes up the duel.
    props.peaceful = 0
    melee.set_ai(true, 0.7)
    local player = world.find("Player")
    if player then melee.lock(player) end
  elseif name == "alert" and alert_left <= 0 then
    alert_left = 12
    melee.set_ai(true, 0.85)
    local player = world.find("Player")
    if player then melee.lock(player) end
  end
end

function on_damaged(amount, attacker)
  -- A duel is to first yield, not to the death: at a quarter of its health the duelist stops, heals a little and pays up.
  if (tonumber(props.duel) or 0) > 0 and not yielded then
    local hp, max = world.health(self.id)
    if hp and max and hp <= max * 0.25 then
      yielded = true
      melee.set_ai(false)
      world.heal(self.id, max * 0.3 - hp)
      local player = world.find("Player")
      hud.announce((world.name(self.id) or "The duelist") .. " yields. \"Enough. You have earned this.\"")
      if player then
        world.send(player, "duel_won", world.name(self.id) or "")
        if props.reward ~= "none" then
          for item in tostring(props.reward):gmatch("[^|]+") do inventory.add(player, item, 1) hud.announce("You receive: " .. item .. ".") end
        end
        world.send(player, "kill", (tonumber(props.qi) or 25))
      end
      return
    end
  end
  -- Someone who stood peacefully fights back once struck.
  if (tonumber(props.peaceful) or 0) > 0 and not yielded then
    props.peaceful = 0
    melee.set_ai(true, 0.7)
    local player = world.find("Player")
    if player then melee.lock(player) end
  end
  if alert_left <= 0 and not PEACEFUL[world.name(self.id) or ""] and (tonumber(props.phases) or 0) == 0 then
    alert_left = 12
    call_friends()
  end
  if (tonumber(props.phases) or 0) > 0 then
    local hp, max = world.health(self.id)
    if hp and max and max > 0 then
      local ratio = hp / max
      local want = ratio < 0.34 and 2 or ratio < 0.67 and 1 or 0
      if want > phase then
        phase = want
        melee.tune(base_damage * (1 + 0.3 * phase), REALM_SPEED[my_realm] * (1 + 0.08 * phase), -1, -1)
        camera.shake(0.5, 0.5)
        hud.announce(phase == 1 and "The guardian's qi surges." or "The guardian's qi blazes. It will not fall easily.")
        for k = 1, 2 do
          local ang = k * math.pi + phase
          world.spawn(props.summon or "Cave Shade", self.x + math.cos(ang) * 3, self.y + 0.5, self.z + math.sin(ang) * 3)
        end
      end
    end
  end
end

function on_tick(dt)
  if alert_left > 0 then alert_left = alert_left - dt end
  -- Afflictions.
  for kind, left in pairs(afflictions) do
    left = left - dt
    if DPS[kind] then dot_acc = dot_acc + DPS[kind] * dt end
    if left <= 0 then
      afflictions[kind] = nil
      if kind == "chill" then melee.tune(-1, 1) end
      if kind == "stun" then melee.set_ai(true) end
    else
      afflictions[kind] = left
    end
  end
  if dot_acc >= 1 then
    local whole = math.floor(dot_acc)
    dot_acc = dot_acc - whole
    world.damage(self.id, whole)
  end
  -- A ring on the ground the moment a telegraphed blow begins.
  if next(telegraph) then
    local move = melee.move()
    if move ~= last_move then
      last_move = move
      if telegraph[move] then mark_ring(0.7) end
    end
  end
end

function on_start()
  local given = tonumber(props.realm) or 0
  my_realm = math.max(1, math.min(7, given > 0 and given or realm_of(world.name(self.id))))
  base_damage = REALM_DAMAGE[my_realm]
  melee.tune(base_damage, REALM_SPEED[my_realm], -1, -1)
  if (tonumber(props.peaceful) or 0) > 0 then melee.set_ai(false) end
  -- Clothes give the mannequin a body: robes, trousers, gloves and boots.
  if props.gear and props.gear ~= "" and props.gear ~= "none" then world.wear(props.gear) end
  for name in tostring(props.telegraph or ""):gmatch("[%w_]+") do
    if name ~= "none" then telegraph[name] = true end
  end
end

-- @prop loot none
-- A crate, barrel or jar: it breaks when struck and may hold something (props.loot: "Item:chance Item:chance").
function on_death(attacker)
  local player = world.find("Player")
  if player then
    for item, chance in tostring(props.loot or ""):gmatch("([%w ]+):([%d.]+)") do
      if item ~= "none" and math.random() < tonumber(chance) then
        inventory.add(player, item, 1)
        hud.announce("You find a " .. item .. ".")
      end
    end
  end
  sound.play("metal hit")
  after(0.05, function() world.destroy(self.id) end)
end

local cache, cached = {}, 0
function tr(s)
  if LANG == "en" or type(s) ~= "string" or s == "" then return s end
  local hit = cache[s]
  if hit then return hit end
  local out = s
  for _, pair in ipairs(ZH) do
    local from, to = pair[1], pair[2]
    local at = out:find(from, 1, true)
    if at then
      local parts, from_at = {}, 1
      while at do
        parts[#parts + 1] = out:sub(from_at, at - 1)
        parts[#parts + 1] = to
        from_at = at + #from
        at = out:find(from, from_at, true)
      end
      parts[#parts + 1] = out:sub(from_at)
      out = table.concat(parts)
    end
  end
  if cached > 400 then cache, cached = {}, 0 end
  cache[s], cached = out, cached + 1
  return out
end

function set_language(code)
  LANG = code == "zh" and "zh" or "en"
  cache, cached = {}, 0
  save.set("jianghu-road-lang", LANG)
end

-- Widgets whose text is words for a reader (not formats the kit parses by name).

local raw_text, raw_announce = ui.set_text, hud.announce
ui.set_text = function(name, text) return raw_text(name, TRANSLATED[name] and tr(text) or text) end

-- Who fights at what strength (the scene builder places this in front of the scripts that need it, with the table filled in).
-- Realm 1 to 7, the same ladder the Player climbs: a fighter of the Player's own realm is an even fight; two realms above
-- is a different kind of danger. Strength is fixed by who they are and where they stand, and nothing scales to the Player.
BEST = { ["Millstream Wolf 1"] = 1, ["Millstream Wolf 2"] = 1, ["Millstream Wolf 3"] = 1, ["Roadside Bandit"] = 1, ["Disciple Fen"] = 1, ["Gray Mane"] = 2, ["Bamboo Wolf 1"] = 2, ["Bamboo Wolf 2"] = 2, ["Black Wind Scout 1"] = 2, ["Black Wind Scout 2"] = 2, ["Black Wind Scout 3"] = 2, ["Captain Rook"] = 3, ["Old Lotus"] = 3, ["Grove Spirit 1"] = 3, ["Grove Spirit 2"] = 3, ["Smuggler 1"] = 2, ["Smuggler 2"] = 2, ["Smuggler 3"] = 2, ["Boss Kang"] = 3, ["Silver Hand Wei"] = 3, ["Iron Fist Elder"] = 4, ["Blood Lotus Duelist"] = 5, ["Frostfang Warden"] = 5, ["Bone Warlord"] = 6 }
PEACEFUL = { ["Disciple Fen"] = true, ["Old Lotus"] = true, ["Silver Hand Wei"] = true, ["Blood Lotus Duelist"] = true }

-- The realm a named fighter stands at: its entry, else its name's first matching word, else 1.
function realm_of(name)
  name = tostring(name or "")
  if BEST[name] then return BEST[name] end
  for pattern, realm in pairs(BEST_BY_WORD) do
    if name:find(pattern) then return realm end
  end
  return 1
end
BEST_BY_WORD = {}

-- What a fight against `them` is for someone of realm `mine`: a short label, the colour word, and a danger from 0 to 4.
function threat_of(them, mine)
  local d = them - mine
  if d <= -2 then return "Trivial", "grey", 0
  elseif d == -1 then return "Easy", "green", 0
  elseif d == 0 then return "Even", "yellow", 1
  elseif d == 1 then return "Hard", "orange", 2
  elseif d == 2 then return "Deadly", "red", 3
  else return "Hopeless", "black", 4 end
end

local function total_of(field)
  local t = 0
  for id in pairs(manuals_learned) do t = t + ((MANUALS[id] or {})[field] or 0) end
  for _, list in ipairs({ { PERKS, perks_learned }, { MERIDIANS, meridians_learned } }) do

end

-- ---- Afflictions from enemy blows: poison, bleeding and burning drain health; a curse weakens your blows; chill slows them.
local AFFLICTIONS = {
  poison = { label = "Poison", dps = 2.5, cure = true }, bleed = { label = "Bleeding", dps = 3.5, cure = true },
  burn = { label = "Burning", dps = 4, cure = true }, curse = { label = "Cursed", cure = true }, chill = { label = "Chilled", cure = true },
}
local function effect_mod(name, on, off) return effects[name] and on or off end

local function learn_manual(id)
  id = tostring(id)
  if manuals_learned[id] or not MANUALS[id] then return end
  manuals_learned[id] = true
  local list = {}
  for k in pairs(manuals_learned) do list[#list + 1] = k end
  save.set("jianghu-manuals", table.concat(list, ","))
  ui.set_text("Notification", "Manual learned\n" .. MANUALS[id].name)

end

local function apply_realm(first)
  local r = REALMS[realm]
  melee.tune(r.damage * (1 + 0.05 * (stage - 1)) * (1 + total_of("dmg")) * effect_mod("curse", 0.75, 1),
    r.speed * (1 + total_of("speed")) * effect_mod("chill", 0.8, 1), r.crit + total_of("crit"), -1,
    r.health * (1 + total_of("hp")), r.mana * (1 + total_of("mana")))
  -- Every realm up to this one has given its arts (a saved game starts here, not from the first); the higher arts replace the lower.
  for i = 1, realm do for move in REALMS[i].unlock:gmatch("[%w_]+") do melee.unlock(move) end end
  for i = 1, realm do for move in (REALMS[i].retire or ""):gmatch("[%w_]+") do melee.relock(move) end end
  if not first then world.heal(self.id, r.health) end
  send("Quests", "realm", realm)
  send("Regions", "realm", realm)
end

local function afflict(name, secs)
  if not AFFLICTIONS[name] then return end
  local had = effects[name]
  effects[name] = { left = secs, max = math.max(secs, had and had.max or 0) }
  if not had and (name == "curse" or name == "chill") then apply_realm(true) end
end
local function cure(all)
  local changed = false
  for name, def in pairs(AFFLICTIONS) do
    if effects[name] and (all or def.cure) then
      effects[name] = nil
      if name == "curse" or name == "chill" then changed = true end
    end
  end
  if changed then apply_realm(true) end
end

local function target_text()
  local t = melee.target()
  if not t or not world.alive(t) then return "", 0 end
  local name = world.name(t) or ""
  local subtitle
  if name:find("^Bandit") then
    subtitle = name:find("Brawler") and "Brawler · Mortal" or name:find("Swordsman") and "Swordsman · Mortal" or name:find("Spearman") and "Spearman · Mortal" or "Qi Adept · Mortal"
  elseif name:find("^Iron") then subtitle = "Qi Gathering"
  elseif name:find("Shade") then subtitle = "Shade · Qi Gathering"
  elseif name:find("Cave Guardian") then subtitle = "Guardian · Foundation"
  elseif name:find("Wolf") then subtitle = "Beast"
  else return "", 0 end
  local tx, _, tz = world.position(t)
  if (tx - self.x) ^ 2 + (tz - self.z) ^ 2 > 22 * 22 then return "", 0 end
  local hp, max = world.health(t)
  return name .. "\n" .. subtitle, (hp or 0) / math.max(1, max or 1)
end

local function tree_text(title, list, learned)
  local lines = { title, insight .. " insight to spend  ·  stages, breakthroughs and ranks give more" }
  for _, perk in ipairs(list) do
    local id, need, xor = perk[1], perk[5], perk.xor
    local state = learned[id] and "learned" or (((need == "" or learned[need]) and not (xor and learned[xor])) and "available" or "locked")
    lines[#lines + 1] = string.format("node|%s|%s|%s|%d|%d|%s|%d|%s|%s", id, perk[2], state, perk[3], perk[4], need, perk[6], perk[7], perk[8])
  end
  return table.concat(lines, "\n")
end

local function learn(list, learned, id)
  for _, perk in ipairs(list) do
    if perk[1] == id and not learned[id] and (perk[5] == "" or learned[perk[5]]) and not (perk.xor and learned[perk.xor]) then
      if insight < perk[6] then hud.announce("Not enough insight for " .. perk[2] .. ".") return end
      insight = insight - perk[6]
      learned[id] = true
      apply_realm(true)
      hud.announce(perk[2] .. " learned: " .. perk[8])
      if save_game then save_game() end
      sound.play("bell")
      return
    end
  end
end

end

-- ---- Using things
local function use_item(name)
  if inventory.count(self.id, name) < 1 or dead then return end
  local r = REALMS[realm]
  local eat = { ["Silver Carp"] = 25, Venison = 35 }
  if name == "Qi Elixir" then
    if qi >= r.need then hud.announce("Your qi is already full.") return end
    inventory.remove(self.id, name, 1)
    qi = math.min(r.need, qi + ELIXIR_QI)
  elseif name == "Jade Dew Pill" then
    inventory.remove(self.id, name, 1)
    world.heal(self.id, 60)
    cure(false)
    sound.play("force field")
  elseif eat[name] then
    inventory.remove(self.id, name, 1)
    world.heal(self.id, eat[name])
    sound.play("coin handle")
  elseif name == "Fire Talisman" then
    if fire_cd > 0 then return end
    inventory.remove(self.id, name, 1)
    fire_cd = 1.5
    local burst = world.find("Qi Burst")
    if burst then world.send(burst, "at", string.format("%.2f,%.2f,%.2f", self.x, self.y - 0.6, self.z)) end
    sound.play("explosion")
    camera.shake(0.4, 0.3)
    for _, id in ipairs(world.overlap(self.x, self.y, self.z, 5.5)) do
      local n = world.name(id) or ""
      if hostile(n) and world.alive(id) then
        world.damage(id, 30)
        world.send(id, "status", "burn|5")
      end
    end
  elseif name == "Ward Talisman" then
    inventory.remove(self.id, name, 1)
    ward = { absorb = 60, left = 20 }
    sound.play("force field")
  elseif name == "Array Flag" then
    inventory.remove(self.id, name, 1)
    formation = { x = self.x, z = self.z, left = 120 }
    send("Qi Array", "at", string.format("%.2f,%.2f,%.2f,120", self.x, self.y - 0.8, self.z))
    sound.play("bell")
  end
end

  tribulation = TRIBULATION
  next_strike = 1.5
  ui.set_text("Notification", "Heavenly tribulation\nLightning gathers. Keep moving!")
  hud.announce("Heavenly tribulation! Keep moving and stay out of the red rings.")

local function strike_at(x, y, z)
  local mark = world.find("Qi Mark")
  if mark then world.send(mark, "at", string.format("%.2f,%.2f,%.2f,1.4", x, y - 0.8, z)) end
  after(1.4, function()
    if dead or tribulation <= 0 then return end
    local burst = world.find("Qi Burst")
    if burst then world.send(burst, "at", string.format("%.2f,%.2f,%.2f", x, y, z)) end
    camera.shake(0.7, 0.4)
    sound.play("explosion")
    if (self.x - x) ^ 2 + (self.z - z) ^ 2 < 9 then world.damage(self.id, REALMS[realm].health * 0.22) end
  end)
end

local function succeed()
  channel = 0
  inventory.remove(self.id, "Breakthrough Pill", 1)
  realm, stage, qi, tribulation = realm + 1, 1, 0, 0
  insight = insight + 2
  apply_realm(false)
  ui.set_text("Notification", "Breakthrough!\nYou have entered the " .. REALMS[realm].name .. " realm.")
  hud.announce("Breakthrough! You are now in the " .. REALMS[realm].name .. " realm.")
  camera.shake(0.6, 0.8)
  sound.play("bell")
  if realm >= FLY_REALM then hud.announce("You can ride the flying sword: press V.") end
  save_game()
end

local function aim()
  local target = melee.target()
  if target and world.alive(target) then
    local tx, _, tz = world.position(target)
    local dx, dz = tx - self.x, tz - self.z
    local d = math.sqrt(dx * dx + dz * dz)
    if d > 0.01 then return dx / d, dz / d end
  end
  return camera.forward()
end

local function qi_effects()
  local move = melee.move()
  local art = QI_ARTS[move] == true
  local active = art or meditating
  if active ~= casting then
    casting = active
    if fx.aura then world.send(fx.aura, "cast", active and 1 or 0) end
  end
  if move == last_move then return end
  last_move = move
  if not art then return end
  sound.play(move == "tiger_rush" and "blade draw" or "force field")
  if move == "qi_palm" and fx.bolt then
    after(0.28, function()
      local fx_, fz_ = aim()
      world.send(fx.bolt, "fire", string.format("%.2f,%.2f,%.2f,%.2f,%.2f", self.x + fx_ * 0.9, self.y + 0.3, self.z + fz_ * 0.9, fx_ * 22, fz_ * 22))
    end)
  elseif (move == "wind_palm" or move == "nine_dragons") and fx.burst then
    after(0.4, function()
      world.send(fx.burst, "at", string.format("%.2f,%.2f,%.2f", self.x, self.y - 0.6, self.z))
      camera.shake(move == "nine_dragons" and 0.7 or 0.4, 0.4)
    end)
  end
end


-- ---- Progress is saved at shrines and altars and when something is learned.
local CARRIED = { "Silver", "Qi Elixir", "Jade Dew Pill", "Breakthrough Pill", "Spirit Herb", "Spirit Stone", "Iron Ore", "Arrow", "Fire Talisman", "Ward Talisman", "Array Flag", "Silver Carp", "Venison", "Raw Venison", "Deer Hide", "Wolf Pelt",
  "Azure Robe", "Azure Robe +1", "Azure Robe +2", "Azure Robe +3", "Iron Gloves", "Iron Gloves +1", "Iron Gloves +2", "Tiger Gloves", "Jade Circlet", "Dragon Crown", "Cloud Silk Robe" }
local WORN = { "body", "hands", "head" }
local function keys_of(t) local out = {} for k in pairs(t) do out[#out + 1] = k end return table.concat(out, ",") end

save_game = function()
  local counts, worn = {}, {}
  for _, name in ipairs(CARRIED) do local n = inventory.count(self.id, name) if n > 0 then counts[#counts + 1] = name .. "=" .. n end end
  for _, slot in ipairs(WORN) do local w = inventory.equipped(self.id, slot) if w ~= "" then worn[#worn + 1] = slot .. "=" .. w end end
  save.set("jianghu-road", string.format("realm=%d;stage=%d;qi=%.1f;insight=%d;spawn=%.2f,%.2f,%.2f;perks=%s;mer=%s;arts=%s;aff=%s;robe=%d;hair=%d;cut=%d;carried=%s;worn=%s",
    realm, stage, qi, insight, spawn[1], spawn[2], spawn[3], keys_of(perks_learned), keys_of(meridians_learned), keys_of(arts_learned), affinity, robe, hair, cut, table.concat(counts, ";"), table.concat(worn, ";")))
end

local function load_game()
  local text = save.get("jianghu-road")
  if not text or text == "" then return false end
  local f = {}
  for k, v in text:gmatch("(%w+)=([^;]*)") do f[k] = v end
  realm = math.max(1, math.min(#REALMS, tonumber(f.realm) or 1))
  stage = math.max(1, math.min(4, tonumber(f.stage) or 1))
  qi = tonumber(f.qi) or 0
  insight = tonumber(f.insight) or insight
  for id in (f.perks or ""):gmatch("[^,]+") do perks_learned[id] = true end
  for id in (f.mer or ""):gmatch("[^,]+") do meridians_learned[id] = true end
  for move in (f.arts or ""):gmatch("[^,]+") do arts_learned[move] = true if move ~= "guardian" then melee.unlock(move) end end
  affinity = f.aff or ""
  robe = math.max(1, math.min(#ROBES, tonumber(f.robe) or 1))
  hair = math.max(1, math.min(#HAIRS, tonumber(f.hair) or 1))
  cut = math.max(1, math.min(#CUTS, tonumber(f.cut) or 1))
  return true, f
end

-- The bag as saved (counts, with the gear that was worn). Items are written "Name=count" separated by ";", which the key=value
-- reader above cannot split, so they are read here from the raw text.
local function load_bag()
  local text = save.get("jianghu-road") or ""
  local carried = text:match("carried=(.-);worn=") or text:match("carried=(.*)$") or ""
  local have = {}
  for name, n in carried:gmatch("([%w +]+)=(%d+)") do have[name] = tonumber(n) end
  for _, slot in ipairs(WORN) do inventory.unequip(self.id, slot) end
  for _, name in ipairs(CARRIED) do
    local want, now = have[name] or 0, inventory.count(self.id, name)
    if want > now then inventory.add(self.id, name, want - now) elseif want < now then inventory.remove(self.id, name, now - want) end
  end
  for slot, item in (text:match("worn=(.*)$") or ""):gmatch("(%a+)=([%w +]+)") do inventory.equip(self.id, slot, item) end
end

function on_start()
  for id in tostring(save.get("jianghu-manuals") or ""):gmatch("[^,]+") do manuals_learned[id] = true end
  fx.aura, fx.bolt, fx.burst = world.find("Qi Aura"), world.find("Qi Bolt"), world.find("Qi Burst")
  for i = 1, 8 do
    local vein = world.find("Spirit Vein " .. i)
    if vein then
      local vx, vy, vz = world.position(vein)
      veins[#veins + 1] = { vx, vz }
    end
  end
  -- props.realm starts further along (for testing and demos).
  realm = math.max(1, math.min(#REALMS, math.floor(tonumber(props.realm) or 1)))
  qi = math.max(0, tonumber(props.qi) or 0)
  inventory.add(self.id, "Azure Robe", 1)
  inventory.equip(self.id, "body", "Azure Robe")
  inventory.add(self.id, "Qi Elixir", 3)
  inventory.add(self.id, "Silver", 40 + math.floor(tonumber(props.silver) or 0))
  inventory.add(self.id, "Jade Dew Pill", 2)
  inventory.add(self.id, "Breakthrough Pill", 1)
  inventory.add(self.id, "Arrow", 12)
  insight = insight + 2 * (realm - 1)
  spawn = { self.x, self.y + 0.5, self.z }
  local loaded = false
  if (tonumber(props.realm) or 1) == 1 and (tonumber(props.silver) or 0) == 0 then
    local ok, f = load_game()
    if ok then
      loaded = true
      load_bag()
      local x, y, z = (f.spawn or ""):match("([%-%d.]+),([%-%d.]+),([%-%d.]+)")
      if x then
        spawn = { tonumber(x), tonumber(y), tonumber(z) }
        world.set_position(self.id, spawn[1], spawn[2], spawn[3])
      end
      hud.announce("Progress loaded. Pray at a shrine to save again.")
    end
  end
  dress()
  apply_realm(true)
  inventory.select(self.id, 1)
  -- props.stance starts in a stance (for testing and demos).
  if props.stance ~= "none" then after(0.8, function() set_stance(props.stance) end) end
  hud.pause_menu(true)   -- Esc opens settings and the key list
  after(0.4, function()
    local list = {}
    for move in pairs(arts_learned) do list[#list + 1] = move end
    send("Quests", "realm", realm)
    send("Regions", "realm", realm)
  end)
  refresh()
end

-- ---- Messages from the other scripts
function on_message(name, value)
  value = tostring(value)
  if name == "kill" then qi = math.min(REALMS[realm].need, qi + (tonumber(value) or 20))
  elseif name == "qi" then qi = math.min(REALMS[realm].need, qi + (tonumber(value) or 0))
  elseif name == "slain" then send("Quests", "slain", value)
  elseif name == "duel_won" then send("Quests", "duel_won", value)
  elseif name == "manual" then learn_manual(value)
  elseif name == "partner" then partner = value == "1"
  elseif name == "insight" then insight = insight + (tonumber(value) or 1)
  elseif name == "hours" then day_hours = tonumber(value) or day_hours
  elseif name == "inside" then
    inside = value
    ui.set_visible("Waypoints", value == "")   -- the valley's markers mean nothing inside a room
  elseif name == "prompt" then prompt_text, prompt_left = value, 0.45
  elseif name == "talk" then
    -- The number keys pick a reply and are also the skill keys, so mana is set aside while talking (a skill needs mana).
    if value == "1" and not held_mana then
      local mana = melee.mana(0)
      held_mana = mana
      melee.mana(-mana)
      talking_now = true
    elseif value == "0" then
      if held_mana then melee.mana(held_mana) held_mana = nil end
      talking_now = false
    end
  elseif name == "learn_art" then
    arts_learned[value] = true
    if value ~= "guardian" then melee.unlock(value) end
    ui.set_text("Notification", "Art learned\n" .. value:gsub("_", " "))
    save_game()
  elseif name == "affinity" then affinity = value save_game()
  elseif name == "rest" then
    local x, y, z = value:match("^([%-%d.]+),([%-%d.]+),([%-%d.]+)$")
    if x then spawn = { tonumber(x), tonumber(y), tonumber(z) } end
    world.heal(self.id, 999)
    if held_mana then held_mana = 999 else melee.mana(999) end
    cure(true)
    save_game()
    hud.announce("You rest. Health and mana restored; you will return here.")
    sound.play("bell")
  elseif name == "mirror" then
    if value == "1" and not creating then
      creating = true
      if not held_mana then held_mana = melee.mana(0) melee.mana(-held_mana) end
      talking_now = true
      mirror_text()
    end
  elseif name == "robe" then
    robe = robe % #ROBES + 1
    dress()
    hud.announce(ROBES[robe][1] .. " robes")
    save_game()
  end
end

-- ---- Hits and deaths
-- What an enemy's blow can leave on you: [name pattern] = { affliction, seconds, chance }.
local INFLICT = {
  { "Qi Adept", "poison", 8, 0.55 }, { "Spearman", "bleed", 5, 0.45 }, { "Iron Fist", "curse", 9, 0.5 },
  { "Wolf", "bleed", 5, 0.5 }, { "Shade", "chill", 6, 0.5 }, { "Cave Guardian", "burn", 5, 0.5 },
}

function on_damaged(amount, attacker)
  if channel > 0 then fail_breakthrough() end
  if ward and amount then
    local soak = math.min(amount, ward.absorb)
    world.heal(self.id, soak)
    ward.absorb = ward.absorb - soak
    if ward.absorb <= 0 then ward = nil end
  end
  if attacker and world.alive(attacker) then
    local who = world.name(attacker) or ""
    for _, rule in ipairs(INFLICT) do
      if who:find(rule[1]) and math.random() < rule[4] then afflict(rule[2], rule[3]) hud.announce(AFFLICTIONS[rule[2]].label .. "!") break end
    end
    -- An arc on the side the blow came from, relative to where the camera looks.
    local ax, _, az = world.position(attacker)
    local fx_, fz_ = camera.forward()
    local dx, dz = ax - self.x, az - self.z
    local forward = dx * fx_ + dz * fz_
    local right = -dx * fz_ + dz * fx_
    hit_flip = 1 - hit_flip   -- a tiny change so a repeat from the same side still counts as new text
    ui.set_text("Damage direction", string.format("%.2f", math.deg(math.atan(right, forward)) + hit_flip * 0.01))
  end
end

-- Your arts take on your affinity: flame burns, frost chills, thunder stuns.
local AFFINE = { flame = "burn|5", frost = "chill|4", thunder = "stun|1.2" }
function on_melee_hit(target, move, damage, outcome)
  if outcome ~= "hit" or affinity == "" or not QI_ARTS[move] then return end
  if world.alive(target) then world.send(target, "status", AFFINE[affinity]) end
end

function on_death()
  dead = true
  if held_mana then melee.mana(held_mana) held_mana = nil end
  talking_now = false
  tribulation = 0
  land()
  channel = 0
  meditating = false
  ui.set_text("Dialogue", "")
  ui.set_text("Death screen", "YOU HAVE FALLEN\nYour qi scatters on the wind.\nRise again")
end

local function respawn()
  dead = false
  ui.set_text("Death screen", "")
  melee.revive()
  cure(true)
  world.set_position(self.id, spawn[1], spawn[2], spawn[3])
  world.set_velocity(self.id, 0, 0, 0)
  qi = qi * 0.5
  deviation = 0
  send("World", "arrive", string.format("%.2f,%.2f,%.2f|", spawn[1], spawn[2], spawn[3]))
end

function on_ui(name, value)
  value = tostring(value)
  if name == "Death screen" and value == "respawn" then respawn()
  elseif name == "Skill tree" and value:sub(1, 5) == "node:" then learn(PERKS, perks_learned, value:sub(6))
  elseif name == "Meridians" and value:sub(1, 5) == "node:" then learn(MERIDIANS, meridians_learned, value:sub(6))
  elseif name == "Inventory" and value:sub(1, 4) == "use:" then use_item(value:sub(5))
  elseif (name == "Character sheet" or name == "Skill tree" or name == "Meridians") and value == "close" then ui.close(name) end
end

-- ---- Sound: the engine's own music and ambience layers. Tension near a fight (or a tribulation), calm exploring music
-- otherwise, silence when dead; wind always, wildlife in the wild, a settled hum inside the sect and the village.
local function audio_tick(dt)
  audio_clock = audio_clock + dt
  if audio_clock < 0.5 then return end
  audio_clock = 0
  local fight = tribulation > 0
  if not fight and not dead then
    for _, id in ipairs(world.overlap(self.x, self.y, self.z, 14)) do
      local n = world.name(id) or ""
      if hostile(n) and world.alive(id) then fight = true break end
    end
  end
  local m = dead and "off" or fight and "wuxia-tension" or (day_hours >= 20 or day_hours < 5) and "wuxia-night" or "wuxia-explore"
  if m ~= mood then mood = m audio.music(m) end
  local settled = false
  for _, name in ipairs({ "Elder Mu", "Merchant Lin" }) do
    local id = world.find(name)
    if id then
      local x, _, z = world.position(id)
      if (x - self.x) ^ 2 + (z - self.z) ^ 2 < 22 * 22 then settled = true end
    end
  end
  if inside == "" then
    audio.ambience("wind", math.min(0.8, 0.3 + math.max(0, self.y - 15) * 0.02))
    audio.ambience("wildlife", settled and 0.1 or 0.6)
    audio.ambience("settlement", settled and 0.8 or 0)
  else
    audio.ambience("settlement", inside == "Great Hall" and 0.5 or 0)
    audio.ambience("wildlife", 0)
  end
end

-- ---- Each tick
function on_tick(dt)
  clock_total = clock_total + dt
  prompt_left = prompt_left - dt
  if dead then audio_tick(dt) return end
  clock = clock + dt
  if creating then
    local changed = false
    for n, key in ipairs({ "1", "2", "3", "4" }) do
      if input.pressed(key) and clock_total - (last_press["m" .. key] or -1) > 0.3 then
        last_press["m" .. key] = clock_total
        changed = true
        if n == 1 then robe = robe % #ROBES + 1
        elseif n == 2 then hair = hair % #HAIRS + 1
        elseif n == 3 then cut = cut % #CUTS + 1
        else
          set_language(LANG == "zh" and "en" or "zh")
          shown = {}
          for _, system in ipairs({ "Quests", "World", "Regions", "Economy" }) do local id = world.find(system) if id then world.send(id, "lang", LANG) end end
        end
      end
    end
    if changed then dress() mirror_text() end
    if tapped("interact") then
      creating = false
      ui.set_text("Dialogue", "")
      if held_mana then melee.mana(held_mana) held_mana = nil end
      talking_now = false
      save_game()
    end
  end
  fire_cd, guardian_cd = math.max(0, fire_cd - dt), math.max(0, guardian_cd - dt)
  audio_tick(dt)
  if deviation > 0 then deviation = math.max(0, deviation - dt) end
  local r = REALMS[realm]
  local vx, vz = self.vx, self.vz
  local vy = self.vy or 0
  local still = (vx * vx + vz * vz) < 2.25   -- under 1.5 m/s (an idle fighter shuffles a little)

  -- Meditation: hold N while standing still. A spirit vein triples it; a planted array doubles it.
  meditating = input.action_down("meditate") and still and not flying and channel == 0
  in_vein = false
  for _, v in ipairs(veins) do
    if (v[1] - self.x) ^ 2 + (v[2] - self.z) ^ 2 < VEIN_RADIUS * VEIN_RADIUS then in_vein = true break end
  end
  local array = false
  if formation then
    formation.left = formation.left - dt
    if formation.left <= 0 then formation = nil
    elseif (formation.x - self.x) ^ 2 + (formation.z - self.z) ^ 2 < 36 then array = true end
  end
  if meditating and qi < r.need then
    qi = math.min(r.need, qi + MEDITATE_QI * (1 + total_of("med")) * (deviation > 0 and 0.4 or 1) * (in_vein and VEIN_BONUS or array and 2 or 1) * (partner and 1.8 or 1) * dt)
    if partner then
      dual_time = dual_time + dt
      if dual_time >= 40 then dual_time = 0 insight = insight + 1 hud.announce("Dual cultivation: your bond with Lan deepens. Insight +1") end
    end
    send("Quests", "med", dt)
  end
  if ward then ward.left = ward.left - dt if ward.left <= 0 then ward = nil end end

  if input.action_pressed("controls") then hud.open_settings() end

  -- Stages within a realm: each quarter of the qi bar is a stage, and each is a little stronger.
  local reached = math.min(4, math.floor(qi / r.need * 4) + 1)
  if reached > stage then
    stage = reached
    insight = insight + 1
    apply_realm(true)
    ui.set_text("Notification", r.name .. "\n" .. STAGES[stage] .. " stage reached")
  end

  -- Things you carry, on keys: Qi Elixir (H), Jade Dew Pill (Z), talismans (8 and 9).
  if tapped("elixir") then use_item("Qi Elixir") end
  if tapped("heal") then use_item("Jade Dew Pill") end
  if tapped("talisman1") then use_item("Fire Talisman") end
  if tapped("talisman2") then use_item("Ward Talisman") end

  -- Scroll arts, once learned: keys 5, 6, 7; the Spirit Guardian on 0.
  if not flying and channel == 0 and not talking_now then
    for action, move in pairs(ART_KEYS) do
      if arts_learned[move] and input.action_pressed(action) then melee.perform(move) end
    end
    if arts_learned.guardian and tapped("art4") and guardian_cd <= 0 and melee.mana(0) >= 40 then
      melee.mana(-40)
      guardian_cd = 40
      local fx_, fz_ = camera.forward()
      world.spawn("Spirit Guardian", self.x + fx_ * 2, self.y + 0.6, self.z + fz_ * 2)
      sound.play("force field")
      hud.announce("A spirit guardian answers your call.")
    end
  end

  -- Qinggong: from Foundation, a second jump in the air; from Golden Core, a third.
  local airborne = math.abs(vy) > 0.6
  if not airborne then air_jumps = 0
  elseif input.action_pressed("jump") and not flying and air_jumps < realm - 2 then
    air_jumps = air_jumps + 1
    world.set_velocity(self.id, vx, 6.2, vz)
    sound.play("cloth swish")
  end

  -- Wall run: airborne and moving into a wall, run up it for a moment (from Qi Gathering; it costs qi).
  if not airborne or flying or realm < 2 then wall_t = 0
  else
    local sp = math.sqrt(vx * vx + vz * vz)
    if sp > 2 and wall_t < 1.3 and qi > 3 then
      local dx, dz = vx / sp, vz / sp
      local hit, _, _, _, _, _, ny = world.raycast(self.x + dx * 0.4, self.y, self.z + dz * 0.4, dx, 0, dz, 0.7)
      if hit and hit ~= "ground" and math.abs(ny or 0) < 0.35 then
        wall_t = wall_t + dt
        qi = math.max(0, qi - 4 * dt)
        world.set_velocity(self.id, vx * 0.15, 3.6, vz * 0.15)
      end
    end
  end

  -- Cloud rope: a grapple to whatever the camera points at (28 m); it pulls you there. Costs qi, recharges in 3 s.
  grapple_cd = math.max(0, grapple_cd - dt)
  if input.action_pressed("grapple") and grapple_cd <= 0 and qi >= 12 and realm >= 2 and not flying and not talking_now then
    local fx_, fz_ = camera.forward()
    local hit, _, hx, hy, hz = world.raycast(self.x, self.y + 1.2, self.z, fx_, 0.2, fz_, 28)
    if hit then
      local dx, dy, dz = hx - self.x, hy - self.y, hz - self.z
      local d = math.max(0.1, math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz))
      qi = qi - 12
      grapple_cd = 3
      grapple = { x = hx - dx / d * 1.3, y = hy - dy / d * 1.3 + 0.4, z = hz - dz / d * 1.3, left = 0.5 }
      sound.play("cloth swish")
      camera.shake(0.15, 0.2)
    else
      hud.announce("Nothing in reach to grapple.")
    end
  end
  if grapple then
    grapple.left = grapple.left - dt
    local dx, dy, dz = grapple.x - self.x, grapple.y - self.y, grapple.z - self.z
    local d = math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz)
    if grapple.left <= 0 or d < 1.2 then
      grapple = nil
      world.set_velocity(self.id, vx * 0.3, math.max(vy, 1), vz * 0.3)
    else
      world.set_velocity(self.id, dx / d * 24, dy / d * 24 + 2, dz / d * 24)
    end
  end

  -- Strong people announce themselves: a pressure on the chest when someone two realms above you is near, before they notice you.
  aura_clock = aura_clock + dt
  if aura_clock >= 1.2 then
    aura_clock = 0
    for _, id in ipairs(world.overlap(self.x, self.y, self.z, 36)) do
      if id ~= self.id and world.alive(id) then
        local name = world.name(id) or ""
        local theirs = realm_of(name)
        if theirs >= realm + 2 and (aura_seen[name] or -999) < clock_total - 120 then
          aura_seen[name] = clock_total
          local label = threat_of(theirs, realm)
          hud.announce("A crushing aura presses on you: " .. name .. ", Realm " .. theirs .. " (" .. label .. ").")
          camera.shake(0.12, 0.5)
        end
      end
    end
  end

  -- Afflictions tick: poison, bleeding and burning cost health; every one wears off.
  for name, e in pairs(effects) do
    e.left = e.left - dt
    local def = AFFLICTIONS[name]
    if def.dps then dot_acc = dot_acc + def.dps * dt end
    if e.left <= 0 then
      effects[name] = nil
      if name == "curse" or name == "chill" then apply_realm(true) end
    end
  end
  if dot_acc >= 1 then
    local whole = math.floor(dot_acc)
    dot_acc = dot_acc - whole
    world.damage(self.id, whole)
  end

  -- Stances (Y): the next weapon, its own moves on the same buttons. A bow spends an arrow a shot.
  if tapped("stance") and channel == 0 and not flying and not talking_now then
    local at = 1
    for i, key in ipairs(STANCE_ORDER) do if key == stance then at = i end end
    local nextkey = STANCE_ORDER[at % #STANCE_ORDER + 1]
    set_stance(nextkey)
    hud.announce(STANCE_LABEL[nextkey] .. " stance")
    sound.play("blade draw")
  end
  if stance == "bow" then
    local have = inventory.count(self.id, "Arrow")
    local mode = melee.state()
    local aiming = input.action_down("aim")
    local draw_time = BOW_DRAW / (1 + 0.08 * (realm - 1))
    local busy = flying or talking_now or dead or mode == "stun" or mode == "down" or mode == "getup" or mode == "airborne" or mode == "block"
    bow_cd, bow_loose = math.max(0, bow_cd - dt), math.max(0, bow_loose - dt)
    if input.action_down("shoot") and have > 0 and not busy and bow_cd <= 0 and bow_loose <= 0 then
      bow_t = math.min(draw_time, bow_t + dt)
    elseif bow_t > 0 then
      local power = bow_t / draw_time
      bow_t = 0
      if power >= BOW_MIN / draw_time and have > 0 and not busy then
        -- Loosed along the camera's line (or at the locked target), spread by how wildly it was drawn.
        local fx, fz, fy = camera.forward()
        local c = math.sqrt(math.max(0, 1 - fy * fy))
        local dx, dy, dz = fx * c, fy, fz * c
        local target = melee.target()
        local tx, ty, tz = nil, nil, nil
        if target then tx, ty, tz = world.position(target) end
        if tx then
          local ex, ey, ez = tx - self.x, ty + 0.2 - (self.y + 0.4), tz - self.z
          local d = math.max(0.1, math.sqrt(ex * ex + ey * ey + ez * ez))
          ey = ey + d * 0.04 -- the arrow falls on the way: aim a little high
          local l = math.sqrt(ex * ex + ey * ey + ez * ez)
          dx, dy, dz = ex / l, ey / l, ez / l
        end
        local cone = math.rad((aiming and BOW_SPREAD.aim or BOW_SPREAD.hip) * (1.5 - power))
        local a, b = math.random() * 2 * math.pi, math.random() * cone
        local rx, rz = -dz, dx
        dx, dy, dz = dx + (rx * math.cos(a)) * b, dy + math.sin(a) * b, dz + (rz * math.cos(a)) * b
        local speed = BOW_SPEED[1] + (BOW_SPEED[2] - BOW_SPEED[1]) * power
        local damage = (BOW_DAMAGE[1] + (BOW_DAMAGE[2] - BOW_DAMAGE[1]) * power) * (1 + 0.15 * (realm - 1))
        if melee.shoot(dx, dy, dz, speed, damage, BOW_DROP) then
          inventory.remove(self.id, "Arrow", 1)
          bow_cd, bow_loose = BOW_NOCK, BOW_LOOSE
          sound.play("sfx:bow:loose" .. string.format("%.2f", power))
          camera.shake(0.05 + 0.08 * power, 0.12)
          if inventory.count(self.id, "Arrow") == 0 then hud.announce("That was your last arrow.") end
        end
      end
    end
    if have == 0 and input.action_pressed("shoot") then hud.announce("Out of arrows. Hunters sell them in Willow Village.") end
    -- A drawn bow slows you, an aimed one more.
    if bow_t > 0 or aiming then
      local hv = (aiming and 0.45 or 0.7)
      world.set_velocity(self.id, vx * hv, self.vy or 0, vz * hv)
    end
    -- What the body shows: the bow low, drawn (paced to the draw time), held, or just loosed.
    local state = bow_loose > 0 and "loose" or bow_t > 0 and (bow_t >= draw_time and "hold" or "draw") or aiming and "ready" or "idle"
    local message = string.format("%s %.2f %d", state, draw_time, aiming and 1 or 0)
    if message ~= bow_sent then
      if state == "draw" and not bow_sent:find("^draw") then sound.play("sfx:bow:draw" .. string.format("%.2f", draw_time)) end
      bow_sent = message
      host.send("bow", message)
    end
  end

  -- Breakthrough: needs full qi and a pill, then a few quiet seconds.
  if input.action_pressed("breakthrough") and channel == 0 and realm < #REALMS and qi >= r.need
     and inventory.count(self.id, "Breakthrough Pill") > 0 and not flying then
    channel = CHANNEL
    hud.announce("You circulate your qi, aiming for the " .. REALMS[realm + 1].name .. " realm...")
  end
  if channel > 0 then
    if not still then fail_breakthrough()
    else
      channel = channel - dt
      if channel <= 0 then if realm >= 2 then begin_tribulation() else succeed() end end
    end
  end

  -- The tribulation's lightning.
  if tribulation > 0 then
    tribulation = tribulation - dt
    next_strike = next_strike - dt
    if next_strike <= 0 and tribulation > 1.6 then
      next_strike = 2.2
      strike_at(self.x, self.y, self.z)
    end
    if tribulation <= 0 and not dead then succeed() end
  end

  -- The flying sword.
  if tapped("fly") then
    if flying then land()
    elseif realm >= FLY_REALM and qi > 5 then
      flying = true
      physics.set_gravity_scale(0)
      world.set_velocity(self.id, vx, 3, vz)
    else
      hud.announce(realm < FLY_REALM and "Only a Foundation cultivator can ride a flying sword." or "Not enough qi to fly.")
    end
  end
  if flying then
    qi = qi - FLY_QI * (1 - total_of("fly")) * dt
    if qi <= 0 then qi = 0; land() hud.announce("Your qi ran dry. The sword falls.")
    else
      local fx_, fz_ = camera.forward()
      local forward = input.action("move_y")
      local strafe = input.action("move_x")
      local up = 0
      if input.action_down("jump") then up = 1 elseif input.action_down("crouch") then up = -1 end
      world.set_velocity(self.id, (fx_ * forward + fz_ * strafe) * FLY_SPEED, up * 7, (fz_ * forward - fx_ * strafe) * FLY_SPEED)
    end
  end

  -- The readouts only need to change a few times a second.
  refresh_clock = refresh_clock + dt
  if refresh_clock >= 0.1 then refresh_clock = 0 refresh() end
  qi_effects()
end
