-- @prop mode aura
-- Qi effects, one emitter per entity (props.mode): "aura" glows around the Player while
-- gathering or casting, "bolt" is the visible core and trail of a Qi Palm, "burst" flashes
-- where a qi art lands, "burn" keeps a struck fighter alight for a few seconds, and "mark" is the red ring that
-- shows where tribulation lightning will fall; "array" is the cyan glow of a planted formation.

local mode = props.mode or "aura"
local ttl = 0        -- bolt: seconds left in flight
local dx, dz = 0, 0  -- bolt: direction * speed
local owner = nil
local target = nil   -- burn: who is burning
local burn_left = 0
local mark_left = 0

local function park()
  self.y = -200
  particles.set_emitting(false)
end

function on_start()
  owner = world.find("Player")
  park()
end

local function hostile(id)
  local name = world.name(id) or ""
  return name:find("^Bandit") or name:find("^Iron Fist")
end

local function hit_at(x, y, z)
  -- The flash, and a fire on whoever stands in it.
  local burst = world.find("Qi Burst")
  if burst then world.send(burst, "at", string.format("%.2f,%.2f,%.2f", x, y, z)) end
  local burn = world.find("Qi Burn")
  for _, id in ipairs(world.overlap(x, y, z, 1.6)) do
    if hostile(id) and burn then world.send(burn, "burn", tostring(id)) break end
  end
  camera.shake(0.3, 0.2)
  sound.play("metal hit")
end

function on_message(name, value)
  if mode == "aura" and name == "cast" then
    particles.set_emitting(value == 1)
  elseif mode == "bolt" and name == "fire" then
    local x, y, z, vx, vz = value:match("^([%-%d.]+),([%-%d.]+),([%-%d.]+),([%-%d.]+),([%-%d.]+)$")
    if x then
      self.x, self.y, self.z = tonumber(x), tonumber(y), tonumber(z)
      dx, dz = tonumber(vx), tonumber(vz)
      ttl = 1.6
      particles.set_emitting(true)
    end
  elseif mode == "burst" and name == "at" then
    local x, y, z = value:match("^([%-%d.]+),([%-%d.]+),([%-%d.]+)$")
    if x then
      self.x, self.y, self.z = tonumber(x), tonumber(y), tonumber(z)
      particles.burst(60)
    end
  elseif (mode == "mark" or mode == "array") and name == "at" then
    local x, y, z, secs = value:match("^([%-%d.]+),([%-%d.]+),([%-%d.]+),([%-%d.]+)$")
    if x then
      self.x, self.y, self.z = tonumber(x), tonumber(y), tonumber(z)
      mark_left = tonumber(secs)
      particles.set_emitting(true)
    end
  elseif mode == "burn" and name == "burn" then
    target = tonumber(value)
    burn_left = 4
    particles.set_emitting(true)
  end
end

function on_tick(dt)
  if mode == "aura" and owner and world.alive(owner) then
    local x, y, z = world.position(owner)
    self.x, self.y, self.z = x, y + 0.2, z
  elseif mode == "bolt" and ttl > 0 then
    ttl = ttl - dt
    self.x, self.z = self.x + dx * dt, self.z + dz * dt
    for _, id in ipairs(world.overlap(self.x, self.y, self.z, 0.8)) do
      if hostile(id) then
        hit_at(self.x, self.y, self.z)
        ttl = 0
        break
      end
    end
    if ttl <= 0 then park() end
  elseif (mode == "mark" or mode == "array") and mark_left > 0 then
    mark_left = mark_left - dt
    if mark_left <= 0 then park() end
  elseif mode == "burn" and burn_left > 0 then
    burn_left = burn_left - dt
    if target and world.alive(target) then
      local x, y, z = world.position(target)
      self.x, self.y, self.z = x, y + 0.2, z
    else
      burn_left = 0
    end
    if burn_left <= 0 then park() end
  end
end

function on_tick(dt)
  if mode == "aura" and owner and world.alive(owner) then
    local x, y, z = world.position(owner)
    self.x, self.y, self.z = x, y + 0.2, z
  elseif mode == "bolt" and ttl > 0 then
    ttl = ttl - dt
    self.x, self.z = self.x + dx * dt, self.z + dz * dt
    for _, id in ipairs(world.overlap(self.x, self.y, self.z, 0.8)) do
      if hostile(id) then
        hit_at(self.x, self.y, self.z)
        ttl = 0
        break
      end
    end
    if ttl <= 0 then park() end

-- @prop mode aura
-- Qi effects, one emitter per entity (props.mode): "aura" glows around the Player while
-- gathering or casting, "bolt" is the visible core and trail of a Qi Palm, "burst" flashes
-- where a qi art lands, "burn" keeps a struck fighter alight for a few seconds, and "mark" is the red ring that
-- shows where tribulation lightning will fall; "array" is the cyan glow of a planted formation.

local mode = props.mode or "aura"
local ttl = 0        -- bolt: seconds left in flight
local dx, dz = 0, 0  -- bolt: direction * speed
local owner = nil
local target = nil   -- burn: who is burning
local burn_left = 0
local mark_left = 0

local function park()
  self.y = -200
  particles.set_emitting(false)
end

function on_start()
  owner = world.find("Player")
  park()
end

local function hostile(id)
  local name = world.name(id) or ""
  return name:find("^Bandit") or name:find("^Iron Fist")
end

local function hit_at(x, y, z)
  -- The flash, and a fire on whoever stands in it.
  local burst = world.find("Qi Burst")
  if burst then world.send(burst, "at", string.format("%.2f,%.2f,%.2f", x, y, z)) end
  local burn = world.find("Qi Burn")
  for _, id in ipairs(world.overlap(x, y, z, 1.6)) do
    if hostile(id) and burn then world.send(burn, "burn", tostring(id)) break end
  end
  camera.shake(0.3, 0.2)
  sound.play("metal hit")
end

local cache, cached = {}, 0
function tr(s)
  if LANG == "en" or type(s) ~= "string" or s == "" then return s end
  local hit = cache[s]
  if hit then return hit end
  local out = s
  for _, pair in ipairs(ZH) do
    local from, to = pair[1], pair[2]
    local at = out:find(from, 1, true)
    if at then
      local parts, from_at = {}, 1
      while at do
        parts[#parts + 1] = out:sub(from_at, at - 1)
        parts[#parts + 1] = to
        from_at = at + #from
        at = out:find(from, from_at, true)
      end
      parts[#parts + 1] = out:sub(from_at)
      out = table.concat(parts)
    end
  end
  if cached > 400 then cache, cached = {}, 0 end
  cache[s], cached = out, cached + 1
  return out
end

function set_language(code)
  LANG = code == "zh" and "zh" or "en"
  cache, cached = {}, 0
  save.set("jianghu-road-lang", LANG)
end

-- The Inventory widget's notes: one "Name|tier|description|use" line for every item.
function inventory_notes()
  local lines = {}
  for name, item in pairs(ITEMS) do
    lines[#lines + 1] = string.format("%s|%d|%s|%s", name, item.tier, item.desc, item.use and "use" or "")
  end
  table.sort(lines)
  return table.concat(lines, "\n")
end

-- The valley's economy (the scene builder places items.lua in front of this): the merchant's shop with buying, selling and
-- buy-back, the alchemy furnace, the anvil that tempers gear, and the quick-slot row. Windows are the Shop window widget;
-- a click arrives as on_ui("Shop window", "pick:<id>" | "tab:<n>" | "page:<±1>" | "close").
local player
local mode = nil            -- "merchant", "alchemy" or "forge"
local tab, page = 1, 1
local buyback = {}          -- { name, n, price } the player sold, newest first
local discount = 0          -- from reputation (Sect sends it)
local note = nil            -- a line shown in place of the subtitle for a moment
local note_left = 0
local clock = 0
local PER_PAGE = 6

-- What the merchant sells: name, price override (otherwise the item's own buy price), and the reputation it needs.
local STOCK = {
  { "Qi Elixir" }, { "Jade Dew Pill" }, { "Arrow", 2, count = 10 }, { "Fire Talisman" }, { "Ward Talisman" },
  { "Breakthrough Pill" }, { "Array Flag" }, { "Iron Gloves" }, { "Jade Circlet" }, { "Tiger Gloves", rep = 20 }, { "Spirit Stone", rep = 10 },
}
local RECIPES = {
  { id = "elixir", out = "Qi Elixir", needs = { ["Spirit Herb"] = 3 } },
  { id = "dew", out = "Jade Dew Pill", needs = { ["Spirit Herb"] = 2 } },
  { id = "pill", out = "Breakthrough Pill", needs = { ["Spirit Herb"] = 8, ["Spirit Stone"] = 1, Silver = 40 } },
  { id = "fire", out = "Fire Talisman", needs = { ["Spirit Herb"] = 2, Silver = 10 } },
  { id = "ward", out = "Ward Talisman", needs = { ["Spirit Herb"] = 3, Silver = 10 } },
  { id = "flag", out = "Array Flag", needs = { ["Spirit Herb"] = 4, ["Spirit Stone"] = 1 } },
  { id = "venison", out = "Venison", needs = { ["Raw Venison"] = 1 } },
}
local rep_good = 0          -- the sect's regard for you, sent by the Sect script

local function me() player = player or world.find("Player") return player end
local function silver() return inventory.count(me(), "Silver") end
local function price_of(name, override) return math.max(1, math.floor((override or ITEMS[name].buy or 1) * (1 - discount) + 0.5)) end
local function say(text) note = text note_left = 3 end

local function needs_text(needs)
  local parts = {}
  for name, n in pairs(needs) do parts[#parts + 1] = n .. " " .. (name == "Silver" and "silver" or name) end
  table.sort(parts)
  return table.concat(parts, ", ")
end
local function has_all(needs)
  for name, n in pairs(needs) do if inventory.count(me(), name) < n then return false end end
  return true
end

local function rows_buy()
  local rows = {}
  for _, entry in ipairs(STOCK) do
    local name, item = entry[1], ITEMS[entry[1]]
    local count = entry.count or 1
    local price = price_of(name, entry[2] and entry[2] * count or nil) * (entry[2] and 1 or count)
    local state = "ok"
    if entry.rep and rep_good < entry.rep then state = "locked" end
    rows[#rows + 1] = { id = name, name = name .. (count > 1 and (" x" .. count) or ""), icon = item.icon, right = state == "locked" and ("needs standing " .. entry.rep) or (price .. " silver"), state = state, detail = item.desc, price = price, count = count }
  end
  return rows
end

local function rows_sell()
  local rows = {}
  local names = {}
  for name in pairs(inventory.list(me())) do names[#names + 1] = name end
  table.sort(names)
  for _, name in ipairs(names) do
    local item = ITEMS[name]
    local have = inventory.count(me(), name)
    if item and (item.sell or 0) > 0 and have > 0 and inventory.equipped(me(), GEAR_SLOT[name] or "none") ~= name then
      rows[#rows + 1] = { id = name, name = name .. (have > 1 and (" x" .. have) or ""), icon = item.icon, right = item.sell .. " silver", state = "ok", detail = item.desc }
    end
  end
  return rows
end

local function rows_back()
  local rows = {}
  for i, b in ipairs(buyback) do
    rows[#rows + 1] = { id = tostring(i), name = b.name .. (b.n > 1 and (" x" .. b.n) or ""), icon = ITEMS[b.name].icon, right = b.price .. " silver", state = "ok", detail = "Buy back what you sold." }
  end
  return rows
end

local function rows_alchemy()
  local rows = {}
  for _, r in ipairs(RECIPES) do
    rows[#rows + 1] = { id = r.id, name = r.out, icon = ITEMS[r.out].icon, right = needs_text(r.needs), state = has_all(r.needs) and "ok" or "locked", detail = ITEMS[r.out].desc }
  end
  return rows
end

local function rows_forge()
  local rows = {}
  for name, up in pairs(GEAR_UP) do
    if inventory.count(me(), name) > 0 then
      local needs = { ["Iron Ore"] = up.ore, Silver = up.silver }
      if up.stone > 0 then needs["Spirit Stone"] = up.stone end
      rows[#rows + 1] = { id = name, name = name .. " > " .. up.to, icon = ITEMS[up.to].icon, right = needs_text(needs), state = has_all(needs) and "ok" or "locked", detail = ITEMS[up.to].desc }
    end
  end
  table.sort(rows, function(a, b) return a.id < b.id end)
  return rows
end

local function rows_now()
  if mode == "merchant" then return tab == 1 and rows_buy() or tab == 2 and rows_sell() or rows_back() end
  if mode == "alchemy" then return rows_alchemy() end
  return rows_forge()
end

local TITLES = { merchant = "Merchant Lin", alchemy = "Alchemy furnace", forge = "Anvil" }

local function show()
  if not mode then return end
  local rows = rows_now()
  local pages = math.max(1, math.ceil(#rows / PER_PAGE))
  page = math.max(1, math.min(page, pages))
  local lines = { TITLES[mode], note or (silver() .. " silver") }
  if mode == "merchant" then lines[#lines + 1] = string.format("tabs|%d|Buy|Sell|Buy back", tab) end
  for i = (page - 1) * PER_PAGE + 1, math.min(#rows, page * PER_PAGE) do
    local r = rows[i]
    lines[#lines + 1] = string.format("row|%s|%s|%s|%s|%s|%s", r.id, r.name, r.icon, r.right, r.state, r.detail)
  end
  if pages > 1 then lines[#lines + 1] = string.format("page|%d|%d", page, pages) end
  ui.set_text("Shop window", table.concat(lines, "\n"))
end

local function open(kind)
  mode, tab, page, note = kind, 1, 1, nil
  ui.open("Shop window")
  show()
end

local function close()
  mode = nil
  ui.close("Shop window")
end

local function add_item(name, n)
  return inventory.add(me(), name, n)
end

local function pick(id)
  if mode == "merchant" then
    if tab == 1 then
      for _, r in ipairs(rows_buy()) do
        if r.id == id then
          if silver() < r.price then say("You cannot afford that.")
          elseif inventory.space(me(), id) < r.count then say("You cannot carry more.")
          else
            inventory.remove(me(), "Silver", r.price)
            add_item(id, r.count)
            sound.play("coin handle")
            say("Bought " .. id .. ".")
          end
        end
      end
    elseif tab == 2 then
      local have = inventory.count(me(), id)
      local item = ITEMS[id]
      if item and have > 0 then
        local n = math.min(have, id == "Arrow" and 10 or 1)
        inventory.remove(me(), id, n)
        inventory.add(me(), "Silver", item.sell * n)
        table.insert(buyback, 1, { name = id, n = n, price = item.sell * n * 2 })
        if #buyback > 8 then table.remove(buyback) end
        sound.play("coin handle")
        say("Sold " .. id .. " for " .. item.sell * n .. ".")
      end
    else
      local b = buyback[tonumber(id)]
      if b then
        if silver() < b.price then say("You cannot afford that.")
        else
          inventory.remove(me(), "Silver", b.price)
          add_item(b.name, b.n)
          table.remove(buyback, tonumber(id))
          sound.play("coin handle")
          say("Bought back " .. b.name .. ".")
        end
      end
    end
  elseif mode == "alchemy" then
    for _, r in ipairs(RECIPES) do
      if r.id == id then
        if not has_all(r.needs) then say("You lack the ingredients.")
        elseif inventory.space(me(), r.out) < 1 then say("You cannot carry more.")
        else
          for name, n in pairs(r.needs) do inventory.remove(me(), name, n) end
          add_item(r.out, 1)
          sound.play("force field")
          say("The furnace glows: " .. r.out .. ".")
          world.send(world.find("Sect"), "brewed", r.out)
        end
      end
    end
  elseif mode == "forge" then
    local up = GEAR_UP[id]
    if up and inventory.count(me(), id) > 0 then
      local needs = { ["Iron Ore"] = up.ore, Silver = up.silver }
      if up.stone > 0 then needs["Spirit Stone"] = up.stone end
      if not has_all(needs) then say("You lack the materials.")
      else
        local slot = GEAR_SLOT[id]
        local worn = slot and inventory.equipped(me(), slot) == id
        if worn then inventory.unequip(me(), slot) end
        for name, n in pairs(needs) do inventory.remove(me(), name, n) end
        inventory.remove(me(), id, 1)
        add_item(up.to, 1)
        if worn then inventory.equip(me(), slot, up.to) end
        sound.play("metal hit")
        say(id .. " becomes " .. up.to .. ".")
        world.send(world.find("Sect"), "forged", up.to)
      end
    end
  end
  show()
end

function on_message(name, value)
  if name == "lang" then set_language(value) return end
  if name == "open" then open(tostring(value))
  elseif name == "discount" then discount = tonumber(value) or 0
  elseif name == "standing" then rep_good = tonumber(value) or 0 end
end

function on_ui(name, value)
  if name ~= "Shop window" then return end
  value = tostring(value)
  if value == "close" then close()
  elseif value:sub(1, 5) == "pick:" then pick(value:sub(6))
  elseif value:sub(1, 4) == "tab:" then tab = tonumber(value:sub(5)) or 1 page = 1 show()
  elseif value:sub(1, 5) == "page:" then page = page + (tonumber(value:sub(6)) or 0) show() end
end

function on_start()
  me()
  ui.set_text("Inventory", inventory_notes())
end

function on_tick(dt)
  clock = clock + dt
  if note_left > 0 then
    note_left = note_left - dt
    if note_left <= 0 then note = nil if mode then show() end end
  end
  -- The quick-slot row: consumables on keys with their counts.
  if clock >= 0.4 and me() then
    clock = 0
    local function row(key, icon, name, label) return string.format("%s|%s|%d|%s", key, icon, inventory.count(player, name), label) end
    ui.set_text("Quick slots", table.concat({
      row("H", "potion", "Qi Elixir", "Qi Elixir"),
      row("Z", "pill", "Jade Dew Pill", "Jade Dew"),
      row("8", "scroll", "Fire Talisman", "Fire Talisman"),
      row("9", "scroll", "Ward Talisman", "Ward Talisman"),
      row("Y", "bullet", "Arrow", "Arrows"),
    }, "\n"))
  end
end

  { "Farewell.", "再会。" },
  { "Never mind", "算了" },
}
table.sort(ZH, function(a, b) return #a[1] > #b[1] end)

local cache, cached = {}, 0
function tr(s)
  if LANG == "en" or type(s) ~= "string" or s == "" then return s end
  local hit = cache[s]
  if hit then return hit end
  local out = s
  for _, pair in ipairs(ZH) do
    local from, to = pair[1], pair[2]
    local at = out:find(from, 1, true)
    if at then
      local parts, from_at = {}, 1
      while at do
        parts[#parts + 1] = out:sub(from_at, at - 1)
        parts[#parts + 1] = to
        from_at = at + #from
        at = out:find(from, from_at, true)
      end
      parts[#parts + 1] = out:sub(from_at)
      out = table.concat(parts)
    end
  end
  if cached > 400 then cache, cached = {}, 0 end
  cache[s], cached = out, cached + 1
  return out
end

function set_language(code)
  LANG = code == "zh" and "zh" or "en"
  cache, cached = {}, 0
  save.set("jianghu-road-lang", LANG)
end

-- Conversation plumbing shared by the scripts that talk to the Player (the scene builder places it in front of them):
-- the Dialogue widget shows what is said and numbered choices; keys 1 to 3 pick one. While a conversation is open the
-- Player script sets its mana aside (the number keys are skill keys too).
TALK_RANGE = 3.6
talking = nil            -- the name of whoever is being talked to
local talk_player

function player_id() talk_player = talk_player or world.find("Player") return talk_player end

-- A tap counts once even when a slow frame runs several ticks.
local last_tap, tap_clock = {}, 0
function tap_tick(dt) tap_clock = tap_clock + dt end
function tapped(action)
  if input.action_pressed(action) and tap_clock - (last_tap[action] or -1) > 0.3 then
    last_tap[action] = tap_clock
    return true
  end
  return false
end

function say(speaker, line, choices)
  local text = speaker .. ": " .. line
  for _, c in ipairs(choices or {}) do text = text .. "\n> " .. c end
  ui.set_text("Dialogue", text)
end

function end_talk()
  if talking then
    talking = nil
    ui.set_text("Dialogue", "")
    local p = player_id()
    if p then world.send(p, "talk", 0) end
  end
end

function start_talk(name)
  talking = name
  local p = player_id()
  if p then world.send(p, "talk", 1) end
end

-- The distance from the Player to a named entity, or nil.
function distance_to(name)
  local p, id = player_id(), world.find(name)
  if not p or not id then return nil end
  local px, _, pz = world.position(p)
  local x, _, z = world.position(id)
  return math.sqrt((px - x) ^ 2 + (pz - z) ^ 2)
end

-- The nearest of these names within talking range, or nil.
function nearest_within(names, range)
  local best, best_d = nil, (range or TALK_RANGE)
  for _, name in ipairs(names) do
    local d = distance_to(name)
    if d and d < best_d then best, best_d = name, d end
  end
  return best
end

-- Walking away ends a conversation; E ends it too. Returns the key (1 to 3) the Player picked, if any.
function talk_poll()
  if not talking then return nil end
  local d = distance_to(talking)
  if not d or d > TALK_RANGE + 2.5 then end_talk() return nil end
  if tapped("interact") then end_talk() return nil end
  for n, key in ipairs({ "1", "2", "3" }) do
    if input.pressed(key) and tap_clock - (last_tap.pick or -1) > 0.3 then
      last_tap.pick = tap_clock
      return n
    end
  end
  return nil
end

-- The world itself (the scene builder places items.lua and talk.lua in front of this, and fills in WAYSTONES): the day and the
-- weather, the waystones that you find on the roads and ride between, and the first look in the mirror on a new road.
-- @prop intro 1
WAYSTONES = { { ["entity"] = "Cloudgate waystone", ["label"] = "Cloudgate" }, { ["entity"] = "Greenhollow waystone", ["label"] = "Greenhollow" }, { ["entity"] = "Port Jade waystone", ["label"] = "Port Jade" }, { ["entity"] = "Peak waystone", ["label"] = "Peak" } }
local sky = fx
local player
local day_hours = 8
local DAY_SECONDS = 720
local rain, weather_left, sky_clock, clock = 0, 45, 2, 0
local found = {}               -- waystone entity -> true once you have been near it
local ride = nil               -- a ride in progress: { x, y, z, left }
local node, at = "root", 1
local menu_for = nil           -- the waystone whose menu is open

local function me() player = player or world.find("Player") return player end

local function persist()
  local list = {}
  for name in pairs(found) do list[#list + 1] = name end
  table.sort(list)
  save.set("jianghu-world", string.format("hours=%.2f;found=%s", day_hours, table.concat(list, ",")))
end

local function discovered()
  local list = {}
  for _, w in ipairs(WAYSTONES) do if found[w.entity] and w.entity ~= menu_for then list[#list + 1] = w end end
  return list
end

local function render(note)
  local list = discovered()
  if node == "root" then
    say(menu_for, note or "A stone older than the road. Touch it and the way is known.", { "Rest here and remember this place", "Travel to another waystone", "Leave" })
  else
    local dest = list[at]
    say(menu_for, note or (dest and ("To " .. dest.label .. " (10 silver).") or "You know no other waystone yet."), dest and { "Go there", "Another place", "Back" } or { "Back" })
  end
end

local function set_lighting()
  sky.time_of_day(day_hours)
end

local function choose(n)
  local list = discovered()
  if node == "root" then
    if n == 1 then
      local id = world.find(menu_for)
      local x, y, z = world.position(id)
      world.send(me(), "rest", string.format("%.2f,%.2f,%.2f", x + 2.2, y + 1.2, z + 2.2))
      persist()
      render("Rested. This is where you will return.")
    elseif n == 2 then node, at = "travel", 1 render()
    else end_talk() end
  else
    local dest = list[at]
    if n == 1 and dest then
      if inventory.count(me(), "Silver") < 10 then render("You need 10 silver.") return end
      inventory.remove(me(), "Silver", 10)
      local id = world.find(dest.entity)
      local x, y, z = world.position(id)
      end_talk()
      ride = { x = x + 2.2, y = y + 1.2, z = z + 2.2, left = 0.8 }
      ui.set_text("Notification", "Travelling\nTo " .. dest.label)
    elseif n == 2 and #list > 0 then at = at % #list + 1 render()
    else node = "root" render() end
  end
end

function on_message(name, value)
  if name == "lang" then set_language(value) return end
  value = tostring(value)
  if name == "waystone" then
    menu_for, node, at = value, "root", 1
    start_talk(value)
    render()
  elseif name == "arrive" then
    -- The Player came back from a fall or a defeat; nothing to do but keep the light right.
    sky_clock = 2
  end
end

function on_start()
  local text = save.get("jianghu-world")
  if text and text ~= "" then
    local h = text:match("hours=([%d.]+)")
    if h then day_hours = tonumber(h) end
    for name in (text:match("found=(.*)$") or ""):gmatch("[^,]+") do found[name] = true end
  elseif (tonumber(props.intro) or 1) > 0 then
    -- A new road starts with a look in the mirror.
    after(2, function() world.send(me(), "mirror", "1") end)
  end
  audio.ambience("wind", 0.35)
  sky.time_of_day(day_hours)
end

function on_tick(dt)
  tap_tick(dt)
  clock = clock + dt
  if not me() then return end
  day_hours = (day_hours + dt * 24 / DAY_SECONDS) % 24
  world.set_clock(day_hours)
  weather_left = weather_left - dt
  if weather_left <= 0 then
    weather_left = 60 + math.random() * 90
    rain = math.random() < 0.3 and 0.35 + math.random() * 0.3 or 0
    sky.weather(rain, rain > 0 and 0.35 or 0.08, 1.5, 0.5)
    audio.ambience("rain", rain)
  end
  sky_clock = sky_clock + dt
  if sky_clock >= 2 then sky_clock = 0 set_lighting() end
  if ride then
    ride.left = ride.left - dt
    if ride.left <= 0 then
      day_hours = (day_hours + 0.25) % 24
      world.set_position(me(), ride.x, ride.y, ride.z)
      world.set_velocity(me(), 0, 0, 0)
      ride = nil
      set_lighting()
    end
  end
  if talking and menu_for then
    local n = talk_poll()
    if not talking then menu_for = nil end
    if n then choose(n) end
  end
  if clock >= 1 then
    clock = 0
    world.send(me(), "hours", string.format("%.2f", day_hours))
    -- Waystones you have been near can be ridden to.
    for _, w in ipairs(WAYSTONES) do
      if not found[w.entity] then
        local d = distance_to(w.entity)
        if d and d < 14 then
          found[w.entity] = true
          ui.set_text("Notification", "Waystone found\n" .. w.label)
          persist()
        end
      end
    end
    save.set("jianghu-world", string.format("hours=%.2f;found=%s", day_hours, (function() local l = {} for k in pairs(found) do l[#l + 1] = k end table.sort(l) return table.concat(l, ",") end)()))
  end
end

local cache, cached = {}, 0
function tr(s)
  if LANG == "en" or type(s) ~= "string" or s == "" then return s end
  local hit = cache[s]
  if hit then return hit end
  local out = s
  for _, pair in ipairs(ZH) do
    local from, to = pair[1], pair[2]
    local at = out:find(from, 1, true)
    if at then
      local parts, from_at = {}, 1
      while at do
        parts[#parts + 1] = out:sub(from_at, at - 1)
        parts[#parts + 1] = to
        from_at = at + #from
        at = out:find(from, from_at, true)
      end
      parts[#parts + 1] = out:sub(from_at)
      out = table.concat(parts)
    end
  end
  if cached > 400 then cache, cached = {}, 0 end
  cache[s], cached = out, cached + 1
  return out
end

function set_language(code)
  LANG = code == "zh" and "zh" or "en"
  cache, cached = {}, 0
  save.set("jianghu-road-lang", LANG)
end

-- Realm 1 to 7, the same ladder the Player climbs: a fighter of the Player's own realm is an even fight; two realms above

-- The realm a named fighter stands at: its entry, else its name's first matching word, else 1.
function realm_of(name)
  name = tostring(name or "")
  if BEST[name] then return BEST[name] end
  for pattern, realm in pairs(BEST_BY_WORD) do
    if name:find(pattern) then return realm end
  end
  return 1
end
BEST_BY_WORD = {}

-- What a fight against `them` is for someone of realm `mine`: a short label, the colour word, and a danger from 0 to 4.
function threat_of(them, mine)
  local d = them - mine
  if d <= -2 then return "Trivial", "grey", 0
  elseif d == -1 then return "Easy", "green", 0
  elseif d == 0 then return "Even", "yellow", 1
  elseif d == 1 then return "Hard", "orange", 2
  elseif d == 2 then return "Deadly", "red", 3
  else return "Hopeless", "black", 4 end
end

local TIER_WORD = { "green", "yellow", "orange", "red", "black" }
local TIER_NAME = { "Safe", "Frontier", "Wild", "Deadly", "Forbidden" }
local REALM_NAMES = { "Mortal", "Qi Gathering", "Foundation", "Golden Core", "Nascent Soul", "Spirit Severing", "Void Ascendant" }
local player
local realm = 1
local current = nil            -- the region the Player is in
local visited = {}
local clock = 0

local function me() player = player or world.find("Player") return player end

-- The innermost region containing the point (the smallest circle wins, so a shrine inside a valley is its own place).
local function region_at(x, z)
  local best, best_r = nil, math.huge
  for _, r in ipairs(REGIONS) do
    for _, c in ipairs(r.circles) do
      local d = math.sqrt((x - c[1]) ^ 2 + (z - c[2]) ^ 2)
      if d < c[3] and c[3] < best_r then best, best_r = r, c[3] end
    end
  end
  return best
end

local function persist()
  local list = {}
  for id in pairs(visited) do list[#list + 1] = id end
  table.sort(list)
  save.set("jianghu-road-regions", "visited=" .. table.concat(list, ","))
end

local function announce(r)
  local first = not visited[r.id]
  visited[r.id] = true
  if first then persist() end
  local lo, hi = r.lo, r.hi
  local span = lo == hi and ("Realm " .. lo) or ("Realms " .. lo .. " to " .. hi)
  local _, word, danger = threat_of(hi, realm)
  local note
  if danger >= 4 then note = "Far beyond you. Turn back or be very careful."
  elseif danger == 3 then note = "Dangerous for you now."
  elseif danger == 2 then note = "A hard road for you."
  elseif realm - lo >= 2 then note = "Little here can hurt you now."
  else note = "A fair place for you." end
  ui.set_text("Notification", string.format("%s\n%s: %s. %s", r.name, TIER_NAME[r.tier], span, note))
  if first then hud.announce(r.name .. ". " .. r.text) end
  world.send(me(), "region", r.id .. "|" .. r.name .. "|" .. r.tier)
end

function on_message(name, value)
  if name == "lang" then set_language(value) return end
  if name == "realm" then realm = tonumber(value) or realm end
end

function on_start()
  local list = tostring(save.get("jianghu-road-regions") or ""):match("visited=(.*)$")
  if list then for id in list:gmatch("[^,]+") do visited[id] = true end end
end

function on_tick(dt)
  clock = clock + dt
  if clock < 0.5 or not me() then return end
  clock = 0
  local x, y, z = world.position(me())
  if not x then return end
  local r = region_at(x, z)
  if r ~= current then
    current = r
    if r then announce(r) end
  end
end

local cache, cached = {}, 0
function tr(s)
  if LANG == "en" or type(s) ~= "string" or s == "" then return s end
  local hit = cache[s]
  if hit then return hit end
  local out = s
  for _, pair in ipairs(ZH) do
    local from, to = pair[1], pair[2]
    local at = out:find(from, 1, true)
    if at then
      local parts, from_at = {}, 1
      while at do
        parts[#parts + 1] = out:sub(from_at, at - 1)
        parts[#parts + 1] = to
        from_at = at + #from
        at = out:find(from, from_at, true)
      end
      parts[#parts + 1] = out:sub(from_at)
      out = table.concat(parts)
    end
  end
  if cached > 400 then cache, cached = {}, 0 end
  cache[s], cached = out, cached + 1
  return out
end

function set_language(code)
  LANG = code == "zh" and "zh" or "en"
  cache, cached = {}, 0
  save.set("jianghu-road-lang", LANG)
end

-- Conversation plumbing shared by the scripts that talk to the Player (the scene builder places it in front of them):
-- the Dialogue widget shows what is said and numbered choices; keys 1 to 3 pick one. While a conversation is open the
-- Player script sets its mana aside (the number keys are skill keys too).
TALK_RANGE = 3.6
talking = nil            -- the name of whoever is being talked to
local talk_player

function player_id() talk_player = talk_player or world.find("Player") return talk_player end

-- A tap counts once even when a slow frame runs several ticks.
local last_tap, tap_clock = {}, 0
function tap_tick(dt) tap_clock = tap_clock + dt end
function tapped(action)
  if input.action_pressed(action) and tap_clock - (last_tap[action] or -1) > 0.3 then
    last_tap[action] = tap_clock
    return true
  end
  return false
end

function say(speaker, line, choices)
  local text = speaker .. ": " .. line
  for _, c in ipairs(choices or {}) do text = text .. "\n> " .. c end
  ui.set_text("Dialogue", text)
end

function end_talk()
  if talking then
    talking = nil
    ui.set_text("Dialogue", "")
    local p = player_id()
    if p then world.send(p, "talk", 0) end
  end
end

function start_talk(name)
  talking = name
  local p = player_id()
  if p then world.send(p, "talk", 1) end
end

-- The distance from the Player to a named entity, or nil.
function distance_to(name)
  local p, id = player_id(), world.find(name)
  if not p or not id then return nil end
  local px, _, pz = world.position(p)
  local x, _, z = world.position(id)
  return math.sqrt((px - x) ^ 2 + (pz - z) ^ 2)
end

-- The nearest of these names within talking range, or nil.
function nearest_within(names, range)
  local best, best_d = nil, (range or TALK_RANGE)
  for _, name in ipairs(names) do
    local d = distance_to(name)
    if d and d < best_d then best, best_d = name, d end
  end
  return best
end

-- Walking away ends a conversation; E ends it too. Returns the key (1 to 3) the Player picked, if any.
function talk_poll()
  if not talking then return nil end
  local d = distance_to(talking)
  if not d or d > TALK_RANGE + 2.5 then end_talk() return nil end
  if tapped("interact") then end_talk() return nil end
  for n, key in ipairs({ "1", "2", "3" }) do
    if input.pressed(key) and tap_clock - (last_tap.pick or -1) > 0.3 then
      last_tap.pick = tap_clock
      return n
    end
  end
  return nil
end

local heard = {}               -- quest id -> true once the giver has told it (even if declined)
local tracked = nil            -- the quest id whose waypoint shows
local dueling = {}             -- person -> true while a duel with them is on
local session = nil            -- the conversation open: { who, kind, q, step, line }
local clock, check = 0, 0
local names = {}
for name in pairs(NPC_DATA) do names[#names + 1] = name end
for name in pairs(THING_DATA) do names[#names + 1] = name end
table.sort(names)

local function me() return player_id() end
local function silver() return inventory.count(me(), "Silver") end

-- ---- Saving
local function persist()
  local rows = {}
  for id, st in pairs(state) do
    local seen, flags = {}, {}
    for k in pairs(st.seen) do seen[#seen + 1] = k end
    for k in pairs(st.flags) do flags[#flags + 1] = k end
    table.sort(seen) table.sort(flags)
    rows[#rows + 1] = table.concat({ id, st.status, st.step or "", tostring(st.n), table.concat(seen, "+"), table.concat(flags, "+"), tostring(st.med) }, ",")
  end
  table.sort(rows)
  local told = {}
  for id in pairs(heard) do told[#told + 1] = id end
  table.sort(told)
  save.set("jianghu-quests", table.concat(rows, ";") .. "|" .. table.concat(told, ",") .. "|" .. (tracked or ""))
end

local function load()
  local text = save.get("jianghu-quests")
  if not text or text == "" then return end
  local rows, told, track = text:match("^(.*)|(.*)|(.*)$")
  if not rows then return end
  for row in rows:gmatch("[^;]+") do
    local id, status, step, n, seen, flags, med = row:match("^([^,]*),([^,]*),([^,]*),([^,]*),([^,]*),([^,]*),([^,]*)$")
    if id and by_id[id] then
      local st = { status = status, step = step ~= "" and step or nil, n = tonumber(n) or 0, seen = {}, flags = {}, med = tonumber(med) or 0 }
      for k in seen:gmatch("[^+]+") do st.seen[k] = true end
      for k in flags:gmatch("[^+]+") do st.flags[k] = true end
      state[id] = st
    end
  end
  for id in told:gmatch("[^,]+") do heard[id] = true end
  tracked = track ~= "" and track or nil
end

-- ---- Finding things
local function step_of(q, id)
  for i, s in ipairs(q.steps) do if s.id == id then return s, i end end
end
local function current(q)
  local st = state[q.id]
  if not st or st.status ~= "active" then return nil end
  return step_of(q, st.step)
end
local function available(q)
  if state[q.id] then return false end
  for _, need in ipairs(q.requires or {}) do if not (state[need] and state[need].status == "done") then return false end end
  return true
end
local function active_ids()
  local list = {}
  for _, q in ipairs(QUEST_DATA) do if state[q.id] and state[q.id].status == "active" then list[#list + 1] = q.id end end
  return list
end

-- ---- The journal, the objective and the one waypoint
local function progress_text(step, st)
  if step.kill then return string.format(" (%d/%d)", math.min(st.n, step.kill.n), step.kill.n) end
  if step.interact then
    local got = 0
    for _, t in ipairs(step.interact) do if st.seen[t] then got = got + 1 end end
    return string.format(" (%d/%d)", got, #step.interact)
  end
  if step.meditate then return string.format(" (%d/%d s)", math.min(math.floor(st.med), step.meditate), step.meditate) end
  return ""
end

local function journal()
  local lines = { "Journal" }
  local function add(q, kind, detail) lines[#lines + 1] = kind .. "|" .. q.name .. "|" .. detail end
  for _, id in ipairs(active_ids()) do
    local q, st = by_id[id], state[id]
    local step = current(q)
    local detail = step and (step.text .. progress_text(step, st)) or ""
    if step and step.have and inventory.count(me(), step.have.item) < step.have.n and step.recover then detail = detail .. " " .. step.recover end
    add(q, id == tracked and "active" or "todo", (id == tracked and "[tracked] " or "") .. detail)
  end
  for _, q in ipairs(QUEST_DATA) do
    if heard[q.id] and available(q) then add(q, "todo", "Speak to " .. q.giver .. ". " .. q.summary) end
  end
  for _, q in ipairs(QUEST_DATA) do
    if state[q.id] and state[q.id].status == "done" then add(q, "done", q.summary) end
  end
  if #lines == 1 then lines[2] = "todo|Nothing yet|Walk up to someone and press E." end
  ui.set_text("Quest log", table.concat(lines, "\n"))
end

local last_marker = ""
local function show_tracking()
  local q = tracked and by_id[tracked]
  local step = q and current(q)
  if not step then
    ui.set_text("Objective", "No quest tracked\nWalk up to someone and press E.")
    ui.set_value("Objective", 0)
    if last_marker ~= "" then ui.clear_marker("Quest") last_marker = "" end
    return
  end
  local st = state[q.id]
  ui.set_text("Objective", q.name .. "\n" .. step.text .. progress_text(step, st))
  local total = #q.steps
  local _, index = step_of(q, step.id)
  ui.set_value("Objective", (index - 1) / total)
  if step.where then
    local x, z = step.where[1], step.where[2]
    local key = string.format("%d,%d", x, z)
    local _, _, gx, gy = world.raycast(x, 400, z, 0, -1, 0, 800)
    local y = gy or (select(2, world.position(me())) or 0)
    ui.marker("Quest", x, y + 5, z, q.name)
    last_marker = key
  elseif last_marker ~= "" then
    ui.clear_marker("Quest")
    last_marker = ""
  end
end

local function track(id)
  tracked = id
  show_tracking()
  journal()
  persist()
end

-- ---- Moving a quest along
local begin_step, finish_step, complete_quest

function begin_step(q, id)
  local st = state[q.id]
  st.step, st.n, st.seen, st.med = id, 0, {}, 0
  local step = step_of(q, id)
  if step and step.interact then st.seen = {} end
  persist()
  show_tracking()
  journal()
end

function complete_quest(q)
  local st = state[q.id]
  st.status, st.step = "done", nil
  local r = q.reward or {}
  local parts = {}
  if r.silver then inventory.add(me(), "Silver", r.silver) parts[#parts + 1] = r.silver .. " silver" end
  if r.qi then world.send(me(), "qi", r.qi) parts[#parts + 1] = r.qi .. " qi" end
  for _, item in ipairs(r.items or {}) do inventory.add(me(), item, 1) end
  if r.items and #r.items > 0 then
    local counts, order = {}, {}
    for _, item in ipairs(r.items) do if not counts[item] then counts[item] = 0 order[#order + 1] = item end counts[item] = counts[item] + 1 end
    for _, item in ipairs(order) do parts[#parts + 1] = (counts[item] > 1 and (counts[item] .. " ") or "") .. item end
  end
  if r.manual then world.send(me(), "manual", r.manual) end
  if r.insight then world.send(me(), "insight", r.insight) end
  ui.set_text("Notification", "Quest complete\n" .. q.name .. (#parts > 0 and (": " .. table.concat(parts, ", ")) or ""))
  sound.play("book open")
  if tracked == q.id then
    local rest = active_ids()
    tracked = rest[1]
  end
  persist()
  show_tracking()
  journal()
end

function finish_step(q, choice)
  local st = state[q.id]
  local step, index = step_of(q, st.step)
  if not step then return end
  if choice and choice.flag then st.flags[choice.flag] = true end
  local nextid = (choice and choice.next) or step.next
  if not nextid then
    local following = q.steps[index + 1]
    nextid = following and following.id
  end
  if nextid then begin_step(q, nextid) else complete_quest(q) end
end

local function accept(q)
  state[q.id] = { status = "active", step = q.steps[1].id, n = 0, seen = {}, flags = {}, med = 0 }
  heard[q.id] = true
  ui.set_text("Notification", "Quest started\n" .. q.name)
  sound.play("book open")
  track(q.id)
end

-- ---- Events from the Player and the fighters
local function each_active(fn)
  for _, id in ipairs(active_ids()) do
    local q = by_id[id]
    local step = current(q)
    if step then fn(q, step, state[id]) end
  end
end

function on_message(name, value)
  if name == "lang" then set_language(value) return end
  value = tostring(value)
  if name == "realm" then realm = tonumber(value) or realm
  elseif name == "slain" then
    each_active(function(q, step, st)
      if step.kill and value:find(step.kill.name) then
        st.n = st.n + 1
        if st.n >= step.kill.n then finish_step(q) else persist() show_tracking() journal() end
      end
    end)
  elseif name == "duel_won" then
    dueling[value] = nil
    each_active(function(q, step) if step.duel == value then finish_step(q) end end)
  elseif name == "med" then
    local dt = tonumber(value) or 0
    each_active(function(q, step, st)
      if step.meditate then
        st.med = st.med + dt
        if st.med >= step.meditate then finish_step(q) end
      end
    end)
  end
end

-- ---- Talking
local function lines_of(session) return session.lines end

local function render()
  local s = session
  if not s then return end
  if s.page <= #s.lines then
    say(s.who, s.lines[s.page], { s.page < #s.lines and "Go on." or (#s.choices > 0 and "..." or "Farewell.") })
    s.paging = true
  else
    local texts = {}
    for _, c in ipairs(s.choices) do texts[#texts + 1] = c.text end
    say(s.who, s.closing or "", texts)
    s.paging = false
  end
end

local function open(who, lines, choices, onpick, closing)
  session = { who = who, lines = lines, choices = choices, page = 1, onpick = onpick, closing = closing }
  start_talk(who)
  render()
end

local function who_has_offer(who)
  for _, q in ipairs(QUEST_DATA) do
    if q.giver == who and available(q) then return q end
  end
end

local function talk_to(who)
  local data = NPC_DATA[who]
  -- 1. A quest step that asks for this person.
  local found
  each_active(function(q, step, st) if not found and step.talk and step.talk.npc == who then found = { q, step } end end)
  if found then
    local q, step = found[1], found[2]
    local choices = {}
    for _, c in ipairs(step.talk.choices or {}) do choices[#choices + 1] = c end
    if #choices == 0 then choices = { { text = "Thank you." } } end
    open(who, step.talk.lines, choices, function(choice) finish_step(q, choice) end, "")
    return
  end
  -- 2. A duel they are waiting for.
  local duel
  each_active(function(q, step) if not duel and step.duel == who then duel = q end end)
  if duel and not dueling[who] then
    open(who, { "Ready? To first yield. Nobody dies." }, { { text = "Begin." }, { text = "Not yet." } }, function(choice)
      if choice.text == "Begin." then
        dueling[who] = true
        local id = world.find(who)
        if id then world.send(id, "challenge", "") end
      end
    end, "")
    return
  end
  -- 3. A quest they have to give.
  local offer = who_has_offer(who)
  if offer then
    heard[offer.id] = true
    open(who, offer.offer.lines, { { text = offer.offer.accept, yes = true }, { text = offer.offer.decline } }, function(choice)
      if choice.yes then accept(offer) else persist() journal() end
    end, "")
    return
  end
  -- 4. Shops and small talk.
  if data and data.shop then
    world.send(world.find("Economy"), "open", data.shop)
    return
  end
  open(who, { data and data.chatter or "..." }, {}, function() end, "")
end

-- A notice board offers what is posted on it.
local function read_board(board)
  local list = {}
  for _, q in ipairs(QUEST_DATA) do if q.board == board and available(q) then list[#list + 1] = q end end
  if #list == 0 then open(board, { "Nothing new is posted." }, {}, function() end, "") return end
  local q = list[1]
  heard[q.id] = true
  open(board, { q.name .. ": " .. q.summary }, { { text = "Take the job.", yes = true }, { text = "Leave it." } }, function(choice)
    if choice.yes then accept(q) end
  end, "")
end

local function touch(thing)
  local data = THING_DATA[thing]
  if data.action == "waystone" then
    world.send(world.find("World"), "waystone", thing)
    return
  elseif data.action == "board" then
    read_board(thing)
    return
  end
  local taken = false
  each_active(function(q, step, st)
    if step.interact then
      for _, t in ipairs(step.interact) do
        if t == thing and not st.seen[t] then
          st.seen[t] = true
          taken = true
          ui.set_text("Notification", (data.note and data.note ~= "") and (thing .. "\n" .. data.note) or thing)
          local all = true
          for _, need in ipairs(step.interact) do if not st.seen[need] then all = false end end
          if all then
            for _, item in ipairs(data.give or {}) do inventory.add(me(), item, 1) end
            finish_step(q)
          else
            persist() show_tracking() journal()
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end)
  if not taken then ui.set_text("Notification", thing .. "\n" .. ((data.note and data.note ~= "") and data.note or "Nothing more to find here.")) end
end

local function choose(n)
  local s = session
  if not s then return end
  if s.page <= #s.lines then
    s.page = s.page + 1
    if s.page > #s.lines and #s.choices == 0 then end_talk() session = nil return end
    render()
    return
  end
  local choice = s.choices[n]
  if not choice then return end
  local pick = s.onpick
  end_talk()
  session = nil
  pick(choice)
end

-- ---- The tick
local function prompt_for(name)
  local data = NPC_DATA[name] or THING_DATA[name]
  if not data then return "talk" end
  if THING_DATA[name] then return THING_DATA[name].prompt end
  local suffix = ""
  local mark = false
  each_active(function(q, step) if (step.talk and step.talk.npc == name) or step.duel == name then mark = true end end)
  if mark or who_has_offer(name) then suffix = " (quest)" end
  return (data.shop and ("trade with " .. name) or ("talk to " .. name)) .. suffix
end

function on_tick(dt)
  tap_tick(dt)
  clock = clock + dt
  check = check + dt
  local p = me()
  if not p then return end
  if talking then
    local n = talk_poll()
    if not talking then session = nil end
    if n then choose(n) end
    return
  end
  -- Enter cycles which quest shows a waypoint: each active quest in turn, then none.
  if tapped("track") then
    local list = active_ids()
    local at = 0
    for i, id in ipairs(list) do if id == tracked then at = i end end
    if at >= #list then
      track(nil)
      ui.set_text("Notification", "Waypoint off\nNo quest is tracked.")
    else
      track(list[at + 1])
      ui.set_text("Notification", "Tracking\n" .. by_id[list[at + 1]].name)
    end
  end
  -- Conditions that watch the world: standing somewhere, carrying something.
  if check >= 0.25 then
    check = 0
    local x, _, z = world.position(p)
    each_active(function(q, step, st)
      if step.reach and (x - step.reach[1]) ^ 2 + (z - step.reach[2]) ^ 2 <= step.reach[3] ^ 2 then finish_step(q)
      elseif step.have and inventory.count(p, step.have.item) >= step.have.n then finish_step(q) end
    end)
  end
  if clock >= 1 then
    clock = 0
    journal()
  end
  -- What E would do here, and doing it.
  local near = nearest_within(names, 3.6)
  if near then
    world.send(p, "prompt", prompt_for(near))
    if tapped("interact") then
      if THING_DATA[near] then touch(near) else talk_to(near) end
    end
  end
end

function on_start()
  load()
  after(0.6, function()
    if not tracked then
      local list = active_ids()
      tracked = list[1]
    end
    show_tracking()
    journal()
    if next(state) == nil and not heard.letter then
      -- A new road: the first person to speak to is at the south gate.
      ui.set_text("Notification", "Jianghu Road\nSpeak to Gatekeeper Jun (E) at the south gate.")
    end
  end)
end
